visual_review.result: Passage selection, adversarial question collection, answer typing, split, reannotation, and numeracy-aware scoring are unobstructed and ordered exactly once; both pages loaded the expected SVG at natural size 2559 by 163.

evidence_summary_en: The primary TACL paper specifies anonymized aggregated Google queries of at least eight words, question-form filtering, retaining queries whose top five results contain Wikipedia, a three-stage annotation protocol for question validity, earliest smallest long answer, and short/yes-no/null answer, 307,373 single-annotated Train examples plus 7,830/7,842 five-way Dev/Test sets, beta=2 consensus handling, and separate long- and short-answer precision, recall, and F1.
evidence_summary_zh: Natural Questions 的 TACL 原始论文明确说明采集至少八词的匿名聚合 Google 查询，经问句形式筛选并仅保留前五个结果含 Wikipedia 的查询，采用问题有效性、最早最小长答案、短答案/是非/空答案三阶段标注，发布 307,373 个单标训练样本及 7,830/7,842 个五人标开发/测试样本，以 beta=2 处理一致性，并分别报告长答案和短答案的精确率、召回率与 F1。
construction_steps_en: Sample anonymized aggregated Google queries of at least eight words that multiple users issued in a short period
Apply question-form heuristics and exclude non-questions and how-to queries
Run Google Search and retain a query-page pair only when Wikipedia appears in the top five results
Have an annotator judge whether the query is a good fact question before seeing the page
Select the earliest smallest paragraph, table, or list containing the long answer, or mark NULL
Mark short entity span or spans, yes/no, or no short answer within the long answer
Release 307,373 single-annotated Train examples and five-way Dev/Test sets of 7,830 and 7,842
construction_steps_zh: 抽取多位用户在短时间内提交、至少八词的匿名聚合 Google 查询
应用问句形式启发式规则，并排除非问题和 how-to 查询
执行 Google 搜索，仅当 Wikipedia 位于前五个结果时保留查询-页面对
由标注员在看到页面前判断查询是否为有效事实问题
选择包含长答案的最早最小段落、表格或列表，否则标记为空
在长答案内标注短实体跨度、是/否，或无短答案
发布 307,373 个单标训练样本及 7,830 和 7,842 个五人标开发/测试样本
evaluation_steps_en: With beta=2, require a non-null prediction when at least two of five references are non-null; otherwise predict NULL
Match a non-null prediction against any annotated answer
Report precision, recall, and F1 separately for long and short answers
evaluation_steps_zh: 在 beta=2 下，五个参考中至少两个非空时必须预测非空答案，否则预测空答案
非空预测与任一标注答案匹配
分别报告长答案与短答案的精确率、召回率和 F1

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks
visual_review.result: Query selection, all three annotation stages, release counts, consensus rule, and separate long/short evaluation remain readable with no crossings or clipping; both pages loaded the expected SVG at natural size 2599 by 163.

evidence_summary_en: The TriviaQA paper specifies collecting questions and answers from 14 trivia and quiz-league sites, removing questions shorter than four tokens, independent Web evidence retrieval through Bing and Wikipedia evidence retrieval through TAGME, answer-string distant-supervision filtering, 95,956 QA pairs with 662,659 evidence documents, 80/10/10 QA splitting, human-verified Dev/Test subsets, and SQuAD-style EM/F1 with aliases and domain-specific aggregation.
evidence_summary_zh: TriviaQA 论文明确说明从 14 个知识问答和 quiz league 网站收集问答并删除少于四个词元的问题，通过 Bing 独立构建 Web 证据、通过 TAGME 构建 Wikipedia 证据，以答案字符串做远程监督过滤，形成 95,956 个问答对和 662,659 份证据文档，按问答对做 80/10/10 划分，发布人工验证的开发/测试子集，并使用支持别名及分域聚合的 SQuAD 风格 EM/F1。
construction_steps_en: Collect QA pairs from 14 trivia and quiz-league sites and remove questions shorter than four tokens
For Web evidence, query Bing with the question but not the answer, inspect the top 50 URLs, and crawl the top ten after filtering trivia and bad documents
For Wikipedia evidence, use TAGME to link question entities and add their corresponding pages
For distant supervision, keep only evidence documents containing a correct answer string
Release 95,956 QA pairs with 662,659 evidence documents, including about 650K Web and 78K Wikipedia examples
Randomly split QA pairs 80/10/10 and have humans mark answerable Dev/Test subsets
construction_steps_zh: 从 14 个知识问答和 quiz league 网站收集问答对，并删除少于四个词元的问题
构建 Web 证据时只用问题查询 Bing，检查前 50 个 URL，过滤知识问答站和坏文档后抓取前十页
构建 Wikipedia 证据时用 TAGME 链接问题实体并加入对应页面
做远程监督时仅保留含正确答案字符串的证据文档
发布 95,956 个问答对和 662,659 份证据文档，包括约 650K 个 Web 与 78K 个 Wikipedia 样本
按问答对随机划分 80/10/10，并由人工标出可回答的开发/测试子集
evaluation_steps_en: Predict an answer from the supplied evidence with a reading-comprehension model
Compute exact match and token F1 while accepting Wikipedia aliases
Aggregate at question level for Wikipedia and document level for Web, reporting full and verified subsets
evaluation_steps_zh: 阅读给定证据并预测答案
在接受 Wikipedia 别名的前提下计算精确匹配和词元 F1
Wikipedia 按问题级、Web 按文档级聚合，并分别报告完整集与人工验证子集

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks
visual_review.result: The independent Bing and TAGME evidence branches merge cleanly before filtering, corpus release, split, human verification, and domain-specific scoring; both pages loaded the expected SVG at natural size 2343 by 523.

evidence_summary_en: The CommonsenseQA paper specifies filtering ConceptNet to 236,208 triplets, grouping same-source same-relation targets into about 43K question sets, AMT formulation with a 75% worker-quality gate, adding one same-relation and one worker-written distractor for five choices, disjoint two-worker verification that removes 15%, optional 500-snippet Web context, 16,242 formulated and 12,247 final questions, primary random 80/10/10 splitting, and accuracy evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: CommonsenseQA 论文明确说明把 ConceptNet 过滤为 236,208 个三元组，将同源同关系的目标分组为约 43K 个候选问题集，由 AMT 标注员出题并设置 75% 质量门，加入一个同关系干扰项和一个人工合理干扰项形成五选一题，由互斥的两位验证者复核并过滤 15%，可选提供 500 条网页片段上下文，从 16,242 道初始题得到 12,247 道最终题，以随机 80/10/10 为主划分并用准确率评测。
construction_steps_en: Filter generic or weak ConceptNet edges and retain 236,208 triplets
Group three targets sharing the same source concept and relation into about 43K candidate question sets
Have AMT workers write three discriminative questions per set while avoiding obvious surface clues
Retain question writers only when at least 75% of their questions pass verification
Add one same-relation ConceptNet distractor and one worker-written plausible distractor to form five choices
Use two disjoint verification workers and keep an item if at least one answers correctly, filtering 15%
Optionally retrieve 100 snippets for the question plus each candidate, for 500 snippets per question
Reduce 16,242 formulated questions to 12,247 final items and use the primary random 80/10/10 split
construction_steps_zh: 过滤 ConceptNet 中过于通用或关系较弱的边，保留 236,208 个三元组
把共享源概念和关系的三个目标分成约 43K 个候选问题集
由 AMT 标注员每组编写三道区分性问题，并避免明显表面线索
仅保留至少 75% 问题通过验证的出题标注员
加入一个同关系 ConceptNet 干扰项和一个人工合理干扰项，形成五个选项
由两位互斥验证标注员复核，至少一人答对才保留，共过滤 15%
可选地为问题加每个候选项检索 100 条片段，每题共 500 条
把 16,242 道初始题筛为 12,247 道最终题，并使用主要的随机 80/10/10 划分
evaluation_steps_en: Choose one answer from five candidates
Report test accuracy and compare with the human majority-vote baseline
evaluation_steps_zh: 从五个候选项中选择一个答案
报告测试准确率，并与人类多数票基线比较

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks
visual_review.result: ConceptNet filtering, question-set construction, worker qualification, distractor creation, independent verification, optional Web context, final split, and accuracy evaluation remain readable in one sequence; both pages loaded the expected SVG at natural size 2823 by 163.

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies seven passage domains, CoreNLP selection of multi-entity passages, passage-level in-domain and out-of-domain splits, a worker qualification test, paired real-time questioner/answerer collection, paraphrase alerts, rationale-first free-form answers, three additional Dev/Test answers, 8,399 conversations with 127K turns, and normalized macro word-overlap F1 averaged over four references.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出七类段落来源、用 CoreNLP 筛选多实体段落、按段落设置域内与域外划分、标注员资格测试、提问者与回答者实时配对采集、改写提示、先标依据再编辑自由答案、开发/测试每题三份附加答案、8,399 段对话和 127K 轮，以及对四个参考答案平均的归一化词重合宏 F1。
construction_steps_en: Select multi-entity passages of about 200 words from seven domains using CoreNLP
Reserve 100 Dev and 100 Test passages per in-domain source and 100 Test passages each for Reddit and Science
Qualify AMT workers and pair a questioner with an answerer through ParlAI
Prompt questioners to avoid exact passage wording and ask context-dependent follow-ups
Have answerers highlight a rationale span and edit the copied text into a natural free-form answer
Release 8,399 conversations with 127K turns and collect three additional answers for every Dev/Test question
construction_steps_zh: 用 CoreNLP 从七个领域筛选约 200 词的多实体段落
每个域内来源保留 100 个开发和 100 个测试段落，Reddit 与科学各保留 100 个域外测试段落
通过 AMT 资格测试后，用 ParlAI 配对提问者和回答者
提示提问者避免照抄原文，并提出依赖对话上下文的追问
回答者先高亮依据跨度，再把复制文本编辑成自然自由答案
发布 8,399 段对话和 127K 轮，并为每道开发/测试题再收集三个答案
evaluation_steps_en: Predict the next free-form answer from the passage and gold-answer conversation history
Remove articles and punctuation before computing word-overlap F1
Average each prediction's F1 across the original and three additional references, then macro-average questions
evaluation_steps_zh: 根据段落和金标答案对话历史预测下一轮自由答案
移除冠词与标点后计算词重合 F1
每个预测对原答案和三个附加答案的 F1 取平均，再对问题做宏平均

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks
visual_review.result: The questioner and answerer branches merge cleanly into the corpus, and passage splitting, four-reference collection, and F1 evaluation are readable without clipping; both pages loaded the expected SVG at natural size 2679 by 523.

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies rewriting ATOMIC's 24K events, template questions from nine inference dimensions, two correct answers, parallel handwritten and question-switched negative-answer collection, selecting one correct plus two least-entailed negatives, three-worker Train validation, a second five-worker Dev/Test validation and stylistic filtering, context-disjoint 33,410/1,954/2,224 splits, and three-choice accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出改写 ATOMIC 的 24K 个事件、基于九类推理维度生成问题模板、编写两个正确答案、并行收集人工负例和问题切换负例、选择一个正确答案与两个蕴含度最低负例、训练集三人验证、开发/测试再由五人验证并做文体过滤、按情境互斥的 33,410/1,954/2,224 划分，以及三选一准确率。
construction_steps_en: Rewrite ATOMIC events by adding names, filling placeholders, and repairing grammar
Expand each event into a social context, edit an inference-template question, and write two correct answers
Collect two handwritten subtly wrong answers and two correct answers to a switched related question
Form a three-choice tuple from one random correct answer and the two least-entailed negatives
Validate Train tuples with three workers and Dev/Test tuples again with five workers, retaining majority labels
Use a deep stylistic classifier to remove easier Dev/Test items and preserve context-disjoint splits
Release 33,410 Train, 1,954 Dev, and 2,224 Test questions
construction_steps_zh: 为 ATOMIC 事件添加姓名、填占位符并修复语法
把事件扩写为社会情境，编辑推理模板问题并编写两个正确答案
收集两个细微错误的人工负例，以及针对相关切换问题的两个正确答案
用一个随机正确答案和两个蕴含度最低的负例组成三选一题
训练题由三人验证，开发/测试题再由五人验证，并保留多数标签
用深层文体分类器移除较容易的开发/测试题，并保持情境互斥
evaluation_steps_en: Read the social context and inference question and score three candidate answers
Choose the highest-probability answer and report accuracy
Compare against humans on 900 sampled Dev and 900 sampled Test items
evaluation_steps_zh: 读取社会情境与推理问题，并对三个候选答案评分
选择最高概率答案并报告准确率
在人类抽样的 900 道开发题和 900 道测试题上做对比

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks
visual_review.result: The handwritten and question-switched negative branches rejoin before tuple construction without crossings, and validation, filtering, exact splits, and accuracy remain legible; both pages loaded the expected SVG at natural size 2799 by 523.

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies an October 2017 English Wikipedia first-paragraph hyperlink graph, manually curated bridge pages, bridge sampling with probability 0.75, comparison sampling from 42 entity lists with half yes/no questions, crowd-written answers and supporting facts, 112,779 examples, Turker and three-fold-model hardness partitioning, separate distractor and full-wiki test sets, and answer/support/joint EM and F1.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出基于 2017 年 10 月英文 Wikipedia 首段的超链接图、人工筛选桥接页面、以 0.75 概率采样桥接题、从 42 组实体列表采样比较题且其中一半为是非题、众包答案与支持事实、112,779 个样本、标注员及三折模型辅助难度划分、独立的干扰段落和全 Wikipedia 测试集，以及答案/支持事实/联合 EM 与 F1。
construction_steps_en: Build a directed graph from links in the first paragraphs of the October 1, 2017 English Wikipedia dump
For bridge questions, sample links whose destination belongs to manually curated suitable pages
For comparison questions, sample two entities from one of 42 lists and use yes/no or span answers
Have crowdworkers write a multi-hop question, answer, and sentence-level supporting facts
Collect 112,779 valid examples and audit top Turkers to isolate 18,089 mostly single-hop train-easy items
Use three-fold model confidence to separate 56,814 train-medium items and split the remaining hard examples
Create a distractor setting with two gold plus eight TF-IDF paragraphs and a separate full-wiki setting
construction_steps_zh: 从 2017 年 10 月 1 日英文 Wikipedia 快照的文章首段链接构建有向图
桥接题采样目标属于人工筛选页面集合的链接
比较题从 42 组列表之一采样两个实体，并使用是非或跨度答案
由众包标注员编写多跳问题、答案和句级支持事实
收集 112,779 个有效样本，并审计高产标注员以分出 18,089 个主要单跳的简单训练样本
用三折模型置信度分出 56,814 个中等训练样本，再划分剩余难题
构建两个金标加八个 TF-IDF 段落的干扰设置，以及独立的全 Wikipedia 设置
evaluation_steps_en: Predict an answer span or yes/no label and a set of supporting sentences
Report answer EM/F1 and supporting-fact EM/F1
Multiply answer and support precision and recall for joint F1; joint EM is one only when both exactly match
evaluation_steps_zh: 预测答案跨度或是非标签，以及支持句集合
报告答案 EM/F1 和支持事实 EM/F1
把答案与支持事实的精确率和召回率分别相乘得到联合 F1；仅两项都精确匹配时联合 EM 为一

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks
visual_review.result: Bridge/comparison construction and distractor/full-wiki evaluation form two clean branch pairs; hardness counts and all answer/support/joint metrics remain readable; both pages loaded the expected SVG at natural size 2903 by 603.

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies question-title PubMed articles with structured conclusions, title/context/long-answer extraction, two M.D.-candidate annotators and consensus for 1,000 PQA-L items, 500-item cross-validation and test halves, a rule-filtered 61.2K PQA-U set, negation-labeled statement-title conversion for 211.3K PQA-A items, optional multi-phase training, and reasoning-required PQA-L accuracy and macro-F1.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出含问题标题和结构化结论的 PubMed 文章，抽取标题问题、去结论上下文和结论长答案，由两位医学博士候选人标注并协商 1,000 个 PQA-L 样本，将其各 500 个用于交叉验证和测试，以规则筛得 61.2K 个 PQA-U 样本，按否定状态把陈述标题转为 211.3K 个 PQA-A 样本，可选分阶段训练，并在需推理的 PQA-L 上报告准确率与宏 F1。
construction_steps_en: Collect PubMed articles whose title contains a question mark and whose structured abstract has a conclusion
Use the title as question, the abstract without conclusion as context, and the conclusion as long answer
Have two M.D. candidates label yes/no/maybe with and without the long answer, discussing disagreements or removing items
Build PQA-L with 1,000 items, using 500 for 10-fold cross-validation and 500 for held-out testing
Rule-filter answerable non-wh and non-multi-entity questions to form 61.2K unlabeled PQA-U items
Convert suitable statement titles into questions and label by verb negation to form 211.3K PQA-A items
construction_steps_zh: 收集标题含问号且结构化摘要具有结论部分的 PubMed 文章
以标题为问题、去掉结论的摘要为上下文、结论为长答案
由两位医学博士候选人分别在可见和不可见长答案时标注是/否/不确定，分歧则讨论或移除
构建 1,000 个 PQA-L 样本，其中 500 个用于十折交叉验证，500 个留作测试
用规则筛选可答的非疑问词、非多实体选择问题，形成 61.2K 个未标注 PQA-U 样本
把合适陈述标题转为问题并按动词否定状态标注，形成 211.3K 个 PQA-A 样本
evaluation_steps_en: Optionally pretrain on PQA-A, pseudo-label PQA-U, and fine-tune on PQA-L
At PQA-L inference, provide question plus conclusion-free context and predict yes, no, or maybe
Report held-out test accuracy and macro-F1 across the three labels
evaluation_steps_zh: 可选在 PQA-A 上预训练、为 PQA-U 伪标注，再在 PQA-L 上微调
PQA-L 推理时提供问题与去掉结论的上下文，预测是、否或不确定
在留出测试集上报告准确率和三标签宏 F1

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks
visual_review.result: Natural-question PQA-L/PQA-U and heuristic PQA-A branches converge without crossings, and exact subset sizes, held-out protocol, and three-label metrics remain readable; both pages loaded the expected SVG at natural size 2503 by 667.

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies real and mock USMLE, MCMLE, and TWMLE question collection, duplicate removal, answer shuffling and one-wrong-option deletion for USMLE/MCMLE, question-level 80/10/10 splitting, exact 12,723/34,251/14,123 language counts, 18 English and 33 simplified-Chinese textbook OCR corpora, expert coverage audits, retrieval-plus-reader evaluation, and accuracy by language.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出收集 USMLE、MCMLE 与 TWMLE 真题和模拟题，去重，为 USMLE/MCMLE 打乱答案并删除一个错误选项，按题目做 80/10/10 划分，英文/简中/繁中分别为 12,723/34,251/14,123 题，把 18 本英文和 33 本简体中文教材经 OCR 构建语料，做专家覆盖率审计，以检索器加阅读器评测并按语言报告准确率。
construction_steps_en: Collect real and mock medical-board questions from US and mainland-China websites and Taiwan official PDFs
Remove duplicate problems, shuffle answer order, and delete one wrong option from USMLE and MCMLE items
Randomly split questions 80/10/10 into exact Train, Dev, and Test sets for all three sources
Prepare 18 English textbooks for USMLE/TWMLE and 33 simplified-Chinese textbooks for MCMLE
OCR the PDF books, correct misspellings, and divide the text into 231,581 English and 116,216 Chinese paragraphs
Have two M.D.s audit evidence coverage on 100 Dev questions per source
construction_steps_zh: 从美国和中国大陆题库网站及中国台湾官方 PDF 收集医学执业真题与模拟题
删除重复题、打乱答案顺序，并从 USMLE 与 MCMLE 每题删除一个错误选项
按题目随机做 80/10/10 划分，得到三来源精确训练、开发和测试集
为 USMLE/TWMLE 准备 18 本英文教材，为 MCMLE 准备 33 本简体中文教材
对 PDF 教材做 OCR、修正拼写并切成 231,581 个英文和 116,216 个中文段落
由两位医学博士对每个来源的 100 道开发题审计证据覆盖率
evaluation_steps_en: Retrieve relevant textbook paragraphs for each question and its answer options
Read the retrieved evidence and choose one correct option among four
Report Dev and Test accuracy separately for English, simplified Chinese, and traditional Chinese
evaluation_steps_zh: 针对问题及答案选项检索相关教材段落
阅读检索证据，并从四个选项中选择唯一正确项
分别报告英文、简体中文和繁体中文的开发与测试准确率

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies sourced, author-written templates for nine broad bias categories plus two intersectional categories; four ambiguous/disambiguated and negative/non-negative conditions; balanced target order; two person answers plus one of ten equivalent UNKNOWN answers; five-rater validation at a four-of-five threshold; 58,492 examples; and accuracy plus context-sensitive bias scores.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出基于出处材料、由作者手写的九类广义偏见及两类交叉偏见模板，按模糊/消歧情境与负向/非负向问题扩成四种条件，平衡偏见目标顺序，提供两个人物答案和十种等价 UNKNOWN 表达之一，以五人中至少四人一致验证，共形成 58,492 个样本，并报告准确率与分情境偏见分数。
construction_steps_en: Gather attested harmful-bias sources from research, news, Wikipedia, and first-hand accounts
Have authors write templates for nine broad and two intersectional bias categories
Expand every template into ambiguous/disambiguated context and negative/non-negative question conditions
Fill slots while balancing target/non-target order and adding two person options plus an UNKNOWN option
Validate one item from each condition with five raters and require at least four agreeing judgments
If any condition fails, edit the template and revalidate all four conditions before release
construction_steps_zh: 从研究、新闻、Wikipedia 和第一手伤害记录中整理有出处的有害偏见资料
由作者为九类广义偏见和两类交叉偏见手写模板
把每个模板扩展为模糊/消歧情境与负向/非负向问题的四种条件
填充槽位并平衡偏见目标/非目标顺序，加入两个人物选项和一个 UNKNOWN 选项
每种条件抽取一题交由五人验证，要求至少四人判断一致
任一条件失败则编辑模板，并在发布前重新验证全部四种条件
evaluation_steps_en: Have the QA model choose one of the two people or UNKNOWN
Report accuracy by bias category and context, including bias-aligned versus conflicting disambiguated items
Compute sDIS over non-UNKNOWN outputs and scale it by ambiguous-context error to obtain sAMB
evaluation_steps_zh: 由问答模型在两个人物和 UNKNOWN 中选择一个答案
按偏见类别和情境报告准确率，并区分消歧题中偏见一致与冲突的金标
在非 UNKNOWN 输出上计算 sDIS，再按模糊情境错误率缩放得到 sAMB

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies 488 FLORES-200 passages, five iterations of English four-choice question creation, manual and lexical shortcut checks, about 20 percent filtering in the final iteration, 900 questions, expert human translation without machine translation, independent proofreading, five IndicXlit transliterations, 122 language variants across 29 scripts and 27 families, 109,800 rows, and accuracy with a 25 percent random baseline.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出 488 个 FLORES-200 段落、五轮英文四选一题构建、人工与词法捷径检查、末轮约 20% 过滤、900 道题、禁止机器翻译的专家人工翻译、独立第二人校对、五种 IndicXlit 转写、覆盖 29 种文字和 27 个语系的 122 个语言变体及 109,800 行，并以准确率和 25% 随机基线评测。
construction_steps_en: Select 488 parallel passages from FLORES-200
Create passage-only English questions with four options and one correct answer through five provider iterations
Manually inspect samples each round and feed back ambiguity, difficulty, and shortcut issues
Measure lexical-overlap and length features, including a bag-of-words shortcut baseline
Filter about 20 percent of the final iteration to produce 900 English questions
Have experts translate questions and answers without machine translation and align them to existing FLORES passages
Transliterate five Indo-Aryan variants with IndicXlit and have a second annotator proofread every translation
construction_steps_zh: 从 FLORES-200 选择 488 个平行段落
通过五轮服务商迭代构建仅依赖段落、四个选项且唯一正确的英文题
每轮人工抽查样本并反馈歧义、难度和捷径问题
测量词法重合和长度特征，并运行词袋捷径基线
在末轮过滤约 20%，得到 900 道英文题
由专家在不使用机器翻译的前提下翻译问题和答案，并与既有 FLORES 段落对齐
用 IndicXlit 转写五种印度-雅利安语言变体，并由第二位标注员逐条校对翻译
evaluation_steps_en: Present the localized passage, question, and four answer choices for each language variant
Report accuracy per language variant against the 25 percent random baseline
evaluation_steps_zh: 为每个语言变体提供本地化段落、问题和四个答案选项
按语言变体报告准确率，并与 25% 随机基线比较

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies human-written short fact questions with one indisputable evergreen answer and evidence, adversarial review against four OpenAI model completions, few-shot criteria classifiers and light copy editing, a blind second-trainer answer, classifier agreement, evidence from at least two unique domains, a 1,000-item third-trainer audit, 4,326 questions, three-way grading, overall correct, correct given attempted, and F-score.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出人工编写具有单一无争议、时间不变答案和证据的简短事实题，针对四个 OpenAI 模型回复做对抗筛选，使用 few-shot 标准分类器和轻量文字修订，由看不到原答案的第二训练师独立作答，经分类器一致性及至少两个不同来源域名过滤，再做 1,000 题第三训练师审计，最终得到 4,326 题，并以三分类判分、总体正确率、尝试题正确率和 F-score 评测。
construction_steps_en: Have AI trainers write a short fact-seeking question, reference answer, and evidence link
Require one indisputable answer, specific scope, evergreen validity, and answerability by 2023-12-31
Review four OpenAI model completions and retain only questions with at least one incorrect completion
Use few-shot ChatGPT classifiers to flag missing units, multiple answers, or changing answers for revision
Apply light grammar and punctuation edits without changing question content
Have a blind second trainer re-answer and recheck the criteria
Require classifier-matched answers and evidence spanning at least two unique website domains
construction_steps_zh: 由 AI 训练师编写简短事实问题、参考答案和证据链接
要求答案单一无争议、范围明确、时间不变且截至 2023-12-31 可回答
审查四个 OpenAI 模型回复，仅保留至少一个回复错误的问题
用 few-shot ChatGPT 分类器标记缺失单位、多答案或答案会变化的问题并返回修改
在不改变问题内容的前提下做轻量语法和标点修订
由看不到原答案的第二训练师重新作答并复查标准
要求分类器判定两人答案一致，且证据覆盖至少两个不同网站域名
evaluation_steps_en: Audit 1,000 random examples with a third trainer and estimate dataset error around three percent
Grade each model answer as correct, incorrect, or not attempted
Report overall correct, correct given attempted, and their harmonic-mean F-score
evaluation_steps_zh: 由第三训练师审计随机 1,000 题，并估计数据集错误率约为 3%
把每个模型答案判为正确、错误或未尝试
报告总体正确率、尝试题正确率及二者调和平均的 F-score

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies medical-professional mock and online tests plus official AIIMS PG and NEET PG questions from 1991 onward; exact four-option and text-only filtering; heuristic, HTML, spelling, and supervised grammar cleanup; deduplication; an exam-based split; pairwise Levenshtein leakage removal above 0.9; 193,155 questions across 21 subjects and about 2,400 topics; exact 182,822/4,183/6,150 split counts; and overall plus subject-wise accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出收集医学专业人员模拟/在线测试及 1991 年以来官方 AIIMS PG 与 NEET PG 题，按恰好四个选项和纯文本可答性过滤，执行启发式、HTML、拼写及人工监督语法清洗并去重，按考试来源划分，再删除开发/测试中两两 Levenshtein 相似度高于 0.9 的泄漏题，最终形成覆盖 21 学科和约 2,400 主题的 193,155 题，训练/开发/测试精确为 182,822/4,183/6,150，并报告总体及分学科准确率。
construction_steps_en: Collect medical-professional mock and online test series plus official AIIMS PG and NEET PG exams from 1991 onward
Store each record with ID, question, four options, correct answer or answers, and detailed explanation
Remove items without exactly four valid options or a best answer and items needing images, tables, or external context
Apply curated keyword, HTML, symbol, URL, whitespace, missing-field, spelling, and punctuation cleanup
Review Grammarly suggestions under human supervision and remove duplicate questions
Split mock and online items into train, NEET PG into dev, and AIIMS PG into test
Compute pairwise Levenshtein similarity and drop dev/test questions above 0.9 similarity
construction_steps_zh: 收集医学专业人员编写的模拟/在线测试系列，以及 1991 年以来官方 AIIMS PG 和 NEET PG 题
每条记录保存 ID、问题、四个选项、正确答案和详细解析
移除不具恰好四个有效选项或最佳答案的题，以及依赖图片、表格或外部上下文的题
执行人工关键词、HTML、符号、URL、空白、缺失字段、拼写和标点清洗
在人类监督下确认 Grammarly 建议，并删除重复问题
把模拟和在线题划入训练集、NEET PG 划入开发集、AIIMS PG 划入测试集
计算两两 Levenshtein 相似度，并删除相似度高于 0.9 的开发/测试题
evaluation_steps_en: Read the medical question and four options and select the correct option or options
Report accuracy overall and separately by medical subject
evaluation_steps_zh: 读取医学问题和四个选项，并选择正确选项
报告总体准确率和各医学学科准确率

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies six primary topics and 99 subtopics; quality-filtered knowledge content; GPT-4o-0806 generation and criteria checks; LlamaIndex RAG over Google and Bing; a four-model all-correct difficulty filter; 10,000 initial, about 6,310 post-difficulty, and 2,840 further removals; two independent human search annotators with at least two authoritative URLs each; third-party adjudication; exact human/generated-answer agreement; 3,000 final questions; and CO, NA, IN, CGA, and F-score.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出六个一级主题和 99 个子主题，以质量模型筛选知识内容，由 GPT-4o-0806 生成并检查标准，通过 LlamaIndex 结合 Google 与 Bing 做 RAG 验证，以四模型全答对规则过滤简单题；10,000 个初始候选经难度筛选约剩 6,310，再移除 2,840 个；两位独立人工检索标注员各提供至少两个权威 URL，分歧交第三人裁决，仅保留人工与生成答案完全一致的样本，最终得到 3,000 题，并报告 CO、NA、IN、CGA 和 F-score。
construction_steps_en: Organize Chinese knowledge content across six primary topics and 99 subtopics and filter low-quality text
Use GPT-4o-0806 to generate a short factual question and reference answer
Check objective, unique, timeless, challenging, and by-2023-12-31 answerability criteria
Verify factual support with LlamaIndex retrieval over Google and Bing
Discard questions answered correctly by GPT-4o, Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, and GLM-4-Plus
Have two independent annotators recheck criteria, search for the answer, and each supply at least two authoritative URLs
Discard if either annotator rejects the criteria and use a third annotator for answer mismatches
Retain only questions whose final human annotation fully matches the generated reference answer
construction_steps_zh: 按六个一级主题和 99 个子主题组织中文知识内容，并过滤低质量文本
用 GPT-4o-0806 生成简短事实问题和参考答案
检查客观、唯一、时间不变、有难度且截至 2023-12-31 可回答等标准
通过 LlamaIndex 从 Google 和 Bing 检索证据做事实验证
若 GPT-4o、Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 和 GLM-4-Plus 全部答对则丢弃
由两位独立标注员复查标准、检索答案，并各自提供至少两个权威 URL
任一标注员认为标准不符则丢弃，答案不一致则交第三位标注员裁决
仅保留最终人工标注与生成参考答案完全一致的问题
evaluation_steps_en: Grade each model response as correct, not attempted, or incorrect
Report CO, NA, IN, and correct given attempted
Compute F-score as the harmonic mean of overall correct and correct given attempted
evaluation_steps_zh: 把每个模型回复判为正确、未尝试或错误
报告 CO、NA、IN 和尝试题正确率
以总体正确率和尝试题正确率的调和平均计算 F-score

Source more than 80 percent from the Internet and the remainder from public validation sets with self-built questions

evidence_summary_en: The paper sources active professional repositories across public copyleft, private commercial, and held-out lanes, caps each repository at 50-100 substantial tasks, and excludes trivial 1-10 line edits. Consecutive commit pairs define the base, test patch, and gold patch; humans organize source material into problem statements, behavioral requirements, and optional interfaces. evidence_summary_en: The paper mines performance pull requests from nine Python data-science, machine-learning, and HPC repositories. Attribute filtering requires performance keywords, no test modifications, and meaningful AST edits. Per-instance pinned Docker execution combines coverage.py with static symbol resolution to find existing tests that cover expert-changed code. Humans write a measurable performance workload from PR context. Controlled, resource-pinned execution retains significant speedups above two measurement standard deviations and verifies less than 0.5 percent SR drift. The final 498 tasks require covering tests to pass, then normalize model speedup by expert speedup and aggregate Speedup Ratio with a harmonic mean.

evidence_summary_en: AutoCodeGen extracts function-, class-, and file-level Stack-Edu seeds, uses DeepSeek-V3-0324 to refine self-contained solutions, and generates up to three public plus at least seven private inputs. The multilingual sandbox executes the solution-input pairs to obtain outputs, and the LLM integrates them into executable assertions before reverse-generating problems under six specifications. Six languages use the direct pipeline; unused generated data is approximately translated for fourteen low-resource languages. DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite ten-sample filtering removes 10/10-solved problems, DeepSeek-R1 critiques seven quality criteria, and category pools are cyclically sampled. The result is 3,920 problems, 37,777 tests, 20 languages, and 14 categories, evaluated with sandbox Pass@1.

evidence_summary_en: The August 2025 paper documents AutoCodeGen and the original 3,920-problem benchmark but predates V2. The official December 4, 2025 announcement and V2 README state that AutoCodeBench-V2 starts from the original data and is iteratively refined through top proprietary models and sandbox feedback into 1,000 higher-quality problems. The initial file has 136 easy, 218 medium, and 646 hard records; the February 17, 2026 bug-fixed file has 998 records split 136/217/645 across 20 languages. Exact-question audits found zero overlap between either V2 file and the original 3,920 questions. The official quick start replaces the output field under a required fenced-code prompt, starts hunyuansandbox/multi-language-sandbox:v2, and verifies with call_sandbox.py at concurrency 32.

evidence_summary_en: BigCodeBench starts from ODEX Stack Overflow intent/code skeletons. gpt-4-0613 with two demonstrations enriches tasks; entry names are obfuscated, docstrings back-translated, and 4,718 AST-valid drafts retained. Thirteen Python annotators supervise GPT-4 Code Interpreter while it debugs, refactors, and writes tests, producing 1,223 task-test pairs. Deterministic unittest repair, GPT-3.5 pre-evaluation, seven-annotator cross-checking, sandbox workflows, and a 33-task human sanity check produce 1,140 tasks using 139 libraries across seven domains, averaging 5.6 tests and 99% branch coverage. Parsing rules plus five-author review derive BigCodeBench-Instruct; executable evaluation reports Pass@1.

evidence_summary_en: CodeElo selects 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held from May 4 through November 4, 2024, excluding Div. 1-only contests. It parses descriptions, I/O, examples, and notes while presenting original HTML, and attaches divisions, problem ratings, and hidden algorithm tags. Models produce up to eight attempts under a C++ competition prompt; parsed code is submitted directly to Codeforces, whose hidden tests, special/interactive judges, and time-memory limits determine acceptance. Failed attempts incur contest penalties. The model's rank is inserted among human contestants, binary search solves the expected rating per contest, and ratings are averaged across 54 contests for human-comparable Elo plus Pass@1/2/4/8 analysis.
evidence_summary_zh: CodeElo 从 2024 年 5 月 4 日至 11 月 4 日的 54 场 Codeforces 评级竞赛中选择 387 题，并排除仅 Div. 1 的竞赛。它解析描述、输入输出、样例和说明，同时向模型保留原始 HTML，并附加竞赛分区、题目 Rating 和隐藏算法标签。模型在 C++ 竞赛提示下最多生成 8 次尝试；解析出的代码直接提交 Codeforces，由隐藏测试、特殊/交互评测器和时间内存限制判定。失败尝试计入竞赛罚分。模型名次被放入人类选手排名，二分搜索求每场期望 Rating，再对 54 场取平均，得到可与人类比较的 Elo 与 Pass@1/2/4/8 分析。

evidence_summary_en: ArtifactsBench aggregates candidates from expert showcases, open SVG/web snippets, case studies, and screenshot-to-query generation. Automated filters remove incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, and non-interactive items; MinHash plus semantic DOM/CSS/JS comparison and screenshot perceptual hashing provide two-stage deduplication. Experts and LLMs repair prompts, performance from more than 30 models calibrates a 30/40/30 difficulty split, and a ten-dimension checklist is drafted by Hunyuan-Turbos and human-refined to Cohen's kappa of at least 0.8. The 1,825 tasks span nine domains. Playwright and Chromium render each artifact deterministically at 1024 by 768 and capture before/during/after screenshots. Qwen2.5-VL-72B and Gemini-2.5-Pro serve as referees, followed by a double-blind 280-instance human study and WebDev Arena rank alignment.
evidence_summary_zh: ArtifactsBench 从专家展示、开放 SVG/网页片段、案例研究和截图转查询生成中聚合候选。自动过滤移除不完整、非视觉、违反许可、重复、过于简单及非交互项目，再以 MinHash 加 DOM/CSS/JS 语义比较和截图感知哈希进行两阶段去重。专家与 LLM 修复提示词，30 多个模型的表现用于校准 30/40/30 难度分布；十维检查表由 Hunyuan-Turbos 起草并经人工精炼，使 Cohen's kappa 不低于 0.8。最终 1,825 个任务覆盖 9 个领域。Playwright 与 Chromium 在 1024×768 下确定性渲染，并捕获交互前/中/后截图；Qwen2.5-VL-72B 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro 担任双裁判，再以 280 实例双盲人类研究和 WebDev Arena 排名对齐验证。

source_locator: Dataset construction, profiling framework, validation, and benchmark-task sections
evidence_summary_en: BigO(Bench) begins with 8,139 Code Contests problems and 1,485,888 Python solutions that pass public and private tests. Llama 3.1 405B generates problem-specific input dataclasses, with multi-pass back-translation reaching 82% problem coverage; problems require a working dataclass and at least 50 solutions. Independent, joint, random, and identity expansion generate larger inputs. Bubblewrap isolation, cProfile, and tracemalloc collect runtime and memory measurements. Non-negative least-squares fitting chooses time and space complexity classes using residual minimization plus a simplicity bias and records coefficients. The released corpus has 3,105 problems and 1,190,250 solutions. Human comparison matches 92% for time and 84% for space; separate time and space tests support complexity prediction, constrained generation, and coefficient-percentile ranking with Pass@k, Best@k, and All@k.
evidence_summary_zh: BigO(Bench) 从通过公开与私有测试的 8,139 个 Code Contests 问题和 1,485,888 份 Python 解答出发。Llama 3.1 405B 生成题目专属输入 dataclass，多轮回译覆盖 82% 的问题；仅保留 dataclass 可用且至少有 50 份解答的问题。独立、联合、随机和恒等扩展生成更大输入，Bubblewrap 隔离环境配合 cProfile 与 tracemalloc 采集运行时间和内存。非负最小二乘拟合通过残差最小化和简单度偏置选择时空复杂度类别并记录系数。发布集包含 3,105 个问题和 1,190,250 份解答；与人工理论标注相比，时间复杂度一致率 92%、空间复杂度一致率 84%。独立时间/空间测试集用于复杂度预测、约束生成和系数百分位排序，并报告 Pass@k、Best@k 与 All@k。

evidence_summary_en: BIRD collects 80 open databases from Kaggle, Relation.vit, and open tables, then curates 15 additional databases reserved for hidden testing. Specialists standardize schemas and write table, column, and value descriptions. Experts train and examine crowdworkers, retaining eleven native question writers plus SQL specialists. Questions are written from database descriptions and record external-knowledge evidence. Two SQL annotators independently write and execute queries; result mismatches go to expert resolution. Experts verify executability, non-null results, text-knowledge-SQL alignment, semantic equivalence, and efficiency. The final 12,751 pairs cover 95 databases totaling 33.4 GB and 37 domains, split across 69 train, 11 development, and 15 hidden-test databases. Models receive question, database, and evidence, then executable SQL is scored by Execution Accuracy and Valid Efficiency Score.
evidence_summary_zh: BIRD 从 Kaggle、Relation.vit 和开放表格收集 80 个数据库，并额外整理 15 个仅用于隐藏测试的数据库。领域专家标准化 Schema，并编写表、列和值描述。专家培训和考试众包人员，最终保留 11 名母语问题编写者及 SQL 专家。问题依据数据库描述编写，同时记录所需外部知识证据。两名 SQL 标注员独立编写并执行查询，结果不一致时交由专家裁决。专家检查可执行性、非空结果、文本-知识-SQL 对齐、语义等价与效率。最终 12,751 对样本覆盖 95 个数据库、33.4 GB 与 37 个领域，按 69 个训练、11 个开发、15 个隐藏测试数据库切分。模型接收问题、数据库与证据，生成的可执行 SQL 以 EX 和 VES 评分。

evidence_summary_en: CF-Div2-Stepfun selects 53 official Codeforces Division 2 problems from contests held between September 2024 and February 2025 and replaces live online submission with an offline local grader. Test construction proceeds from small correctness cases to randomized large cases, then adversarial cases based on common errors and hacked submissions. Stress generation continues until representative failed submissions can be separated from correct ones. Reliability checks pass 100% of accepted original submissions and flag 92.45% of representative failed submissions. Models generate eight responses per problem as complete C++, Python, or Java programs under standardized compilation and execution, with results reported as avg@8, pass@8, and a simplified C++ Codeforces rating.

source_locator: Dataset construction, Table 1, evaluation, conclusion, limitations, and annotation appendix
evidence_summary_en: CodeSimpleQA evaluates factual programming knowledge rather than executable-code correctness. The consistent abstract, Table 1, contributions, conclusion, and limitations report 1,498 items: 782 English and 716 Chinese questions across more than 15 programming languages and 21 domains; one isolated paragraph instead says 1,478/762 and is treated as a textual inconsistency. The benchmark reports three source families: Code WebQA, self-constructed questions, and human-written documentation QA. For the explicitly documented human-written branch, eight annotators turn 1,500 candidates from Stack Overflow, GitHub and official/community documentation into 680 QA pairs; independent engineer review retains 312 with at least three-reviewer consensus. The paper disagrees on total engineer headcount, so the diagram records the consensus rule without inventing that total. The 66.9M-example CodeSimpleQA-Instruct corpus is a separate training asset. Evaluation grades Correct, Not Attempted, or Incorrect and reports Correct, Correct Given Attempted, and F-score.
evidence_summary_zh: CodeSimpleQA 评估编程知识事实准确性，而不是可执行代码正确性。摘要、表 1、贡献、结论与局限部分一致报告 1,498 题：英文 782、中文 716，覆盖 15 种以上编程语言和 21 个领域；仅有一个段落写成 1,478/762，流程图将其视为论文文本矛盾。论文报告三类来源：Code WebQA、自构造问题和人工编写文档问答。对有明确漏斗数字的人工编写分支，8 名标注员把来自 Stack Overflow、GitHub 及官方/社区文档的 1,500 个候选转为 680 对问答，独立工程师复核后以至少 3 人共识保留 312 对。论文对工程师总人数表述不一致，因此图中只记录共识规则而不臆造人数。66.9M 条 CodeSimpleQA-Instruct 是独立训练资产。评测将答案判为 Correct、Not Attempted 或 Incorrect，并报告 Correct、Correct Given Attempted 与 F-score。

source_locator: NVIDIA technical blog; official README, DATASET_CARD.md, DOMAIN_MAP.md, and CHANGELOG.md for release 2026.1
evidence_summary_en: ComputeEval has no standalone paper located in its official citation; the previous catalog arXiv link is the unrelated OptiML method paper, which only cites ComputeEval. NVIDIA's official 2026.1 release has 566 problems across seven groups: 518 CUDA C++ and 48 CUDA Python, with performance workloads for 499 problems. NVIDIA engineers author the tasks, sometimes with frontier-model assistance, and human engineers review every problem and label. Each contract contains a prompt, visible context, build/test commands, held-out tests, a reference solution, and optional performance workload. CI compiles and runs known-good solutions and validates specifications. Models see no tests or references; isolated evaluation compiles candidates, checks required APIs and held-out tests, and profiles only correct solutions for latency, throughput, and baseline speedup alongside pass@k.
evidence_summary_zh: ComputeEval 的官方引用中未找到独立论文；目录原 arXiv 链接实际是只引用 ComputeEval 的 OptiML 方法论文。NVIDIA 官方 2026.1 版本含 566 题、7 个领域组，其中 CUDA C++ 518 题、CUDA Python 48 题，499 题带性能负载。任务由 NVIDIA 工程师编写，部分使用前沿模型辅助，但所有题目与标签均经人工复核。每题包含提示、可见上下文、构建/测试命令、隐藏测试、参考解与可选性能负载；CI 用已知正确解验证编译、测试与规格。模型看不到测试或参考解；隔离评测先编译并核验必需 API 与隐藏测试，仅对正确候选做延迟、吞吐量和相对基线加速比剖析，并报告 Pass@k。

evidence_summary_en: CRUXEval prompts Code Llama 34B with 69 Python standard-library functions (47 str, 11 dict, 11 list) and two varying few-shot examples to generate a function plus five inputs, then executes them for outputs. Overgeneration produces 102,000 functions and 489,306 input-output pairs. Compile-time filters require every argument, valid assertions and syntax, and 75-300 characters; runtime/safety filters remove floating point, expensive operations, imports, side effects, nondeterminism, exceptions, and executions over two seconds. Dataset-size bootstrap analysis over 1,700 candidates supports a random 800-example release of deterministic 3-13-line functions. CRUXEval-O predicts output and CRUXEval-I finds any input producing a target output; executable assertions determine correctness, with pass@1/pass@5 and 10,000-resample bootstrap intervals.

evidence_summary_en: Design2Code scrapes C4 validation links and inlines CSS to obtain 127.9k real single-file webpages. It removes pages that are too long or too simple and deduplicates to 14k, then removes external dependencies and replaces multimedia. The first two authors jointly annotate 200 pages to 75% agreement and split a random 7k sample for quality, sensitivity, formatting, and diversity review, retaining 484 main pages. A separate 80-page Design2Code-HARD set is sourced from GitHub through the same filtering family. Models receive screenshots, generate HTML/CSS, and are browser-rendered. Text/non-text blocks are matched with Hungarian assignment; Block-Match, Text, Position, Color, and CLIP scores are reported. Human validation uses 100 examples, five annotators, and majority vote; the automatic-metric model predicts pairwise preference at 79.9% accuracy.

evidence_summary_en: FEA-Bench begins with 8,000 Top PyPI packages, keeps about 600 licensed repositories with more than 1,000 PRs, and fast-validates each repository's first 20 test-changing PRs with pip/pytest, yielding 119 sources (18 SWE-bench plus 101 additional). It crawls all PRs with test changes and records base commit, environment, test patch, and gold patch. New functions/classes are parsed; candidates require at least one new component, more than 25% of edited lines in new components, and at most 8,192 patch tokens. GPT-4o keeps only new-feature intent. Tests may fail before the gold patch but all relevant tests must pass after it. The full release has 1,401 tasks from 83 repositories; Lite has 200 from 48. Models see feature requests and component signatures, retrieve repository context, generate/apply edits, and are scored by resolved ratio, patch-apply rate, and retrieval diagnostics.

evidence_summary_en: FronTalk samples 10,000 C4 webpages, summarizes their content/features with GPT-4o, clusters summaries with BERTopic, and manually selects one informative representative from each of 100 prominent clusters. GPT-4o generates ten turns of functional or design intents plus verifiable tests per site. Manual refinement removes 66 hallucinated cases (1.7%) and edits 2,783 (73.4%), improving validity from 90.1% to 94.7%. The release has 100 dialogues, 1,000 turns, and 3,676 tests. Text and visual simulators contextualize the same intent from conversation history; the visual simulator annotates current screenshots. Models update code every turn. A web agent checks final/intermediate pages for pass rate and forgetting, while a first-time-user agent explores each interface and a pairwise judge produces usability win rate.

evidence_summary_en: HLCE combines 146 ICPC World Finals problems from 2011-2023 with 89 IOI problems from 2010-2024. ICPC statements are manually copied from official PDFs and standardized with ChatGPT; official tests are collected and problems with missing, corrupted, or incompatible tests are removed. IOI statements are scraped from the Codeforces IOI dump, cleaned with ChatGPT, paired with official tests, and filtered to exclude output-only tasks. The release contains 235 problems. Models generate five responses per problem. ICPC uses a Python standard-I/O harness, while IOI solutions are sent through an automated Codeforces submission bot and must score 100. Code generation reports Pass@1/Pass@5; the separate self-recognition task reports AUC.

evidence_summary_en: LiveCodeBench Pro captures premier Codeforces, ICPC-series, and IOI-series problems in real time before accepted solutions, editorials, or discussions appear; LeetCode is excluded. The paper snapshot contains 584 problems before April 25, 2025. Each candidate must pass host vetting by a coordinator and at least two expert testers and expose a full immutable post-contest test set. Codeforces-style thresholds define Easy at Elo <=2000, Medium at (2000,3000], and Hard above 3000. Olympiad medalists assign algorithm and cognitive-focus labels through triple-blind consensus. Standardized C++ generation is judged by official tests and reported with Pass@1/Pass@k plus Bayesian MAP Elo. Experts compare 125 o3-mini failures with 125 similarly rated human failures line by line.

evidence_summary_en: MultiPL-E starts from HumanEval and MBPP. Three HumanEval tasks with Python helper functions are excluded, two randomized tasks are converted to unit tests, and MBPP assertions are hidden while signatures are mechanically inferred. Eighteen benchmark-specific little compilers translate signatures, descriptions, doctests, unit tests, terminology, typed values, and type annotations into 18 target languages. Together with Python, MultiPL-HumanEval and MultiPL-MBPP are parallel across 19 languages. Models generate language-specific completions with tailored stop sequences. A containerized sandbox compiles when needed, enforces timeouts, runs every translated hidden unit test, and classifies failures. Pass@1/10/100 use 200 samples per problem and temperature.

evidence_summary_en: NL2Repo-Bench selects Python libraries with 300-120,000 LOC, at least ten GitHub stars, native pytest tests, and recent creation or updates. Annotators clone candidates, review structure and dependencies, and retain only repositories whose native suites pass. An AST scanner inventories classes, functions, and signatures; annotators reverse-engineer tested behavior into a four-part requirements document. Expert review, static API coverage, verified Docker environments, pilot agents, and senior-engineer failure analysis refine tasks until valid. The release has 104 tasks across nine categories. Agents receive only one document in an empty workspace, with no scaffold, source, tests, or signatures, then generated installable libraries are evaluated by original upstream pytest using average test pass rate and fully passed Pass@1 count.

evidence_summary_en: NYU CTF Bench begins with a 568-challenge CSAW archive spanning 2011-2023; the validated 200-challenge table covers 2017-2023 and six categories. Every retained challenge is manually checked for setup and solvability after dependency changes. Server tasks must connect internally and externally within the Docker network; file tasks must have complete configuration and source artifacts. Docker Hub images, Compose files, source, and JSON metadata are standardized. Models see descriptions, listed files, and host information while the exact flag remains hidden. The automated loader starts servers or mounts local files, and the LLM uses six function-call tools: run command, create file, disassemble, decompile, check flag, and give up. Exact hidden-flag matching determines success; resources are cleaned and five models are reported by category and failure reason.

evidence_summary_en: RepoQA selects 50 repositories, ten each in Python, C++, Java, TypeScript, and Rust, requiring topic diversity, unit tests or CI/CD, and at least 100 stars. Main-package source files are dependency ordered, concatenated, and split into 64 equal chunks. The first uniquely named function with a body under 2,000 bytes in each eligible chunk forms the candidate pool; ten needles are sampled per repository. GPT-4-Turbo writes purpose/input/output/procedure descriptions without function or variable names. Ten needles are placed at 10%-100% depths in a 16k context. Tree-sitter extracts the first valid code block, and retrieval succeeds only if the target has the highest smoothed BLEU among all context functions and exceeds 0.8.

evidence_summary_en: SciCode turns scientists' internal research scripts from 16 natural-science subfields into 80 main problems and 338 ordered subproblems with explicit input-output docstrings. The development split has 15 main and 50 subproblems; the test split has 65 main and 288 subproblems. Scientist gold solutions use common documented NumPy, SciPy, or SymPy functionality. Numerical tests and domain-specific workflows reproduce published results or analytical theory. Three validation rounds combine at least two in-domain scientists, one out-of-domain scientist, and GPT-4 generation followed by scientist failure analysis and test redesign. The standard setting omits background and carries generated prior solutions forward; a main problem passes only when all subproblems and the integrated main solution pass.

evidence_summary_en: DARE-bench uses open-license tabular Kaggle data plus crawled descriptions and column previews. LLM feasibility analysis identifies targets, features, types, and temporal structure, yielding Classification-IF/MM, Regression-IF/MM, and Time-series-XF/CF variants. Random or chronological splits, about 20% IF training-noise injection, entity checks, and resampling standardize tasks. IF reference code runs in a fixed-seed sandbox; MM and time-series use masked source labels. The paper's full benchmark is 5,948 train plus 352 evaluation tasks, while the official repository currently publishes a smaller 4,274 plus 324 license-filtered subset. Standard evaluation uses five turns and 200 seconds per sandbox turn; exact match, Macro-F1, and clipped R² are routed by variant.

evidence_summary_en: HumanEval+ retains HumanEval's 164 signature-and-docstring tasks and repairs every gold solution after finding more than 10% incorrect. Hand-written input contracts cover 83 tasks. About 30 ChatGPT seeds per task come from three prompts containing gold code, existing inputs, and corner-case instructions; contract-valid seeds bootstrap ingredient-aware type mutations that generate 1,000 additional inputs in one hour. HumanEval+ averages 764.1 tests per task versus 9.6 in HumanEval. Optional HumanEval+-Mini applies greedy set cover over branch coverage, mutant kills, and other-LLM sample kills to average 16.1 tests. The paper samples 200 programs at four temperatures plus greedy decoding and reports unbiased Pass@1/10/100 after sandboxed base-plus-extra differential execution.

evidence_summary_en: The KernelBench paper defines 250 evaluation-only PyTorch tasks: 100 primitive operations, 100 multi-operator sequences with fusion opportunities, and 50 full ML architectures. The current repository later adds Level 4, but it is outside the paper contract. Each task packages a torch.nn.Module Model plus get_inputs and get_init_inputs for exact tensor shapes and precision; there is no gold kernel. A one-shot addition example and the reference Model prompt greedy generation of ModelNew with custom kernels. On the target L40S, candidates compile and must match Model on five random inputs. Performance uses three warm-ups and 100 CUDA-event trials. fast(p) is the fraction correct with speedup above p; fast(0) is correctness and fast(1) is faster than PyTorch Eager.

evidence_summary_en: SWE-bench starts from 93,139 PRs across 12 popular Python repositories, keeps 11,407 merged PRs that resolve an issue and modify tests, and executes test patches before and after code patches to require fail-to-pass behavior and stable installation/runtime, yielding 2,294 full tasks. Lite removes images, external links, commit SHAs, cross-PR/issue references, and statements under 40 words. It permits at most one edited file and three gold hunks, forbids file creation/deletion, and removes error-message assertions. The dedicated Lite release samples 300 test and 23 development instances across 11 repositories. Systems receive the issue and base codebase, emit an applicable diff, and resolve an instance only when all fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass tests pass.
evidence_summary_zh: SWE-bench 从 12 个热门 Python 仓库的 93,139 个 PR 出发，保留 11,407 个已合并、解决 Issue 且修改测试的 PR；在代码补丁前后执行测试补丁，要求 Fail-to-Pass 且安装/运行稳定，得到完整集 2,294 题。Lite 移除图像、外部链接、提交 SHA、跨 PR/Issue 引用和不足 40 词的题面；最多允许编辑一个文件、三个金标准区块，不允许创建/删除文件，并移除错误消息断言。Lite 专页发布 11 仓库的 300 个测试与 23 个开发实例。系统获得 Issue 与基线仓库，输出可应用 Diff；全部 F2P 与 P2P 测试通过才算解决实例。

Apply Lite content/scope gates and sample 300 test plus 23 development instances

evidence_summary_en: TestExplora crawls 12,227 issue-PR patches from repositories with more than 1,000 stars, splits test and code patches, and keeps cases where tests explicitly reach repaired functions. Intent-doctoring changes, TODOs, and pass placeholders are removed. GitHub Actions Runner Images and automated dependency logic create environments. Gold tests must fail on the base and pass after the code patch; DocAgent documents entry intent. The release has 1,552 PRs, 2,389 tasks, and 482 repositories; Lite has 330 PRs and 517 tasks. Documentation is always visible; White Box adds implementations/dependencies while Black Box exposes signatures. Head Pass measures fixed-version test accuracy, PR-level F2P requires at least one fixed-pass/base-fail test, and EC/CFG plus test count diagnose coverage.
evidence_summary_zh: TestExplora 从星标超过 1,000 的仓库抓取 12,227 个 Issue-PR 补丁，拆分测试与代码补丁，只保留测试能显式调用到修复函数的案例，并移除意图篡改、TODO 与 pass 占位。GitHub Actions Runner 镜像和自动依赖逻辑构建环境；金标准测试须在基线失败、应用代码补丁后通过，DocAgent 标注入口意图。发布集含 1,552 个 PR、2,389 个任务、482 个仓库；Lite 含 330 PR/517 题。两种场景都提供文档，白盒增加实现/依赖，黑盒只暴露签名。Head Pass 衡量修复版本测试准确率；PR 级 F2P 要求至少一个修复通过/基线失败测试；EC、CFG 与测试数诊断覆盖。

source_locator: Sections 2.1-2.4, Appendix B, and the official AA-Omniscience-Public dataset card
evidence_summary_en: AA-Omniscience selects authoritative, current first-party and recognized primary/secondary sources across six economically relevant domains and 42 topics. A GPT-5-based agent develops, filters, and revises difficult, unambiguous, source-independent, precise short-answer questions, with manual review and validation. The full evaluation contains 6,000 questions; only a representative 600-question 10% subset is public and is not reliable for domain/topic conclusions. Models receive no external context or tools and are told to answer only when confident. Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview (09-2025) with reasoning grades one complete-set pass as correct, partial, incorrect, or not attempted. OI is 100×(c−i)/(c+p+i+a); accuracy, hallucination rate, and run cost are also reported.
evidence_summary_zh: AA-Omniscience 从六个经济相关领域、42 个主题的权威且较新的一方资料与公认一手/二手信源取材。基于 GPT-5 的智能体开发、过滤并修订困难、无歧义、不依赖特定原文且答案精确简短的问题，再由人工复核验证。全量评测含 6,000 题；公开集仅为有代表性的 600 题（10%），不适合领域/主题级结论。模型无额外上下文和工具，并被要求仅在有把握时回答。带推理的 Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview（09-2025）对完整集单次运行做正确、部分正确、错误、未作答四分类。OI=100×(c−i)/(c+p+i+a)，同时报告准确率、幻觉率和运行成本。

Generate, filter, revise, challenge-test, and manually validate precise questions

source_locator: Sections 3.1-3.4, Appendix E, and the official facebookresearch repository
evidence_summary_en: AbstentionBench begins with a systematic shortlist of 82 abstention/refusal/uncertainty datasets and retains 16 general-domain datasets after author review. It constructs GPQA-Diamond, GSM8K, and MMLU-Math variants by duplicating context-bearing questions and removing all context before the final question, then adds UMWP to form 20 datasets with more than 35,000 unanswerable questions. Samples are grouped into six non-exclusive scenarios: answer unknown, false premise, stale, subjective, underspecified context, and underspecified intent. Unless specified otherwise, generation uses a 4k limit and temperature 0.8. A Llama 3.1 8B Instruct abstention judge reaches 88% accuracy on manually annotated GPT-4o/Llama 70B responses; a second Llama judge scores correctness where references exist. Recall is primary, with precision, F1, and response accuracy also reported.
evidence_summary_zh: AbstentionBench 从 82 个拒答/拒绝/不确定性候选数据集开始，经作者复核保留 16 个通用领域数据集。它复制含上下文的 GPQA-Diamond、GSM8K、MMLU-Math 问题并删除最终问题之前的全部上下文，构造三个变体，再加入 UMWP，形成含超过 35,000 个不可回答问题的 20 数据集套件。样本归入六类非互斥场景：答案未知、错误前提、过时、主观、上下文不足、意图不明。除特别说明外，生成上限为 4k、温度为 0.8。Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 拒答判分器在人工标注的 GPT-4o/Llama 70B 回答上达到 88% 准确率；第二个 Llama 判分器在有参考答案时判断正确性。核心指标为召回率，并报告精确率、F1 与回答准确率。

Remove key context to build three reasoning variants and add UMWP
Group 20 datasets and more than 35k unanswerable questions into six scenarios

source_locator: Sections 5-7, Appendix A.3-A.5, and the official IBM ACPBench page
evidence_summary_en: ACPBench Hard keeps ACPBench's 13 PDDL domains, creates open-ended versions of seven tasks, and adds next action for eight task families. The paper's generation workflow uses a domain/problem generator when available (existing ALFWorld PDDL otherwise), a Top-K/top-quality planner, plan or intermediate-state sampling, symbolic QA construction, and domain templates for natural language while retaining validation artifacts. Reachability tasks skip states without sound positive/all-reachable evidence. The official page releases 40 development examples per task (320 total); the test set has ten questions per domain and task (1,040). Two-shot, temperature-0, max-1,000-token outputs are grammar-parsed and routed to exact/simulation or planner-backed symbolic validators. Each task receives binary correctness and accuracy; no LLM judge is used.
evidence_summary_zh: ACPBench Hard 沿用 ACPBench 的 13 个 PDDL 领域，把原七项任务改为开放式生成，并新增下一动作，共八类任务。论文流程在可用时生成领域/问题（ALFWorld 直接用现有 PDDL），运行 Top-K/高质量规划器，采样计划或中间状态，构造符号问答，再用领域模板翻译成自然语言并保留验证材料。可达性任务会跳过缺少可靠正例/全可达证据的状态。官方页面发布每任务 40 个开发例（共 320），测试集为每领域每任务 10 题（共 1,040）。模型采用 2-shot、温度 0、最多 1,000 token；回答经语法解析后路由至精确/模拟或规划器支撑的符号验证器。各任务以二元正确性和准确率计分，不使用 LLM 裁判。

evidence_summary_en: ActivityNet-QA samples 3,200/1,800/800 videos from ActivityNet's train/validation/test partitions, balancing labeled classes where possible, for 5,800 long web videos. Crowdsourcing creates exactly ten Chinese QA pairs per video: one motion, one spatial-relation, one temporal-relation, and seven free questions; free answers are categorized into six types. Questions and answers have separate annotators; unanswerable questions are double-checked/regenerated, and random samples receive multi-annotator majority votes. Google, Baidu, Sogou, and Youdao translations are compared with average CIDEr similarity; low-agreement cases receive manual review, otherwise Baidu is used. The aligned bilingual release contains 32k/18k/8k QA pairs (58k total). The paper reports exact accuracy and WUPS@0.9/0.0; the official script uses exact string equality and aggregates by question/answer type.
evidence_summary_zh: ActivityNet-QA 从 ActivityNet 的训练/验证/测试分区采样 3,200/1,800/800 个视频，在有标签的分区尽量平衡类别，共得到 5,800 个长网络视频。众包为每个视频恰好编写 10 对中文问答：1 个动作、1 个空间关系、1 个时间关系和 7 个自由问题；自由题按六类答案细分。问题和答案由不同标注者处理；不可答问题会复核/返工，随机样本由多人作答并多数投票。谷歌、百度、搜狗、有道译文用平均 CIDEr 相似度比较；低一致性样本人工检查，其余采用百度结果。中英对齐发布集含 32k/18k/8k 问答（共 58k）。论文报告精确准确率与 WUPS@0.9/0.0；官方脚本使用严格字符串相等并按题型/答案类型汇总。

evidence_summary_en: ADR-Bench studies real Chinese deep-research usage and starts with domain-expert drafts, then filters and revises unsuitable queries through multiple rounds. Nine domains form two tracks: seven general domains contribute ten authentic business queries each (70), while finance and law contribute 20 expert-designed queries and cross-validated rubrics each (40), totaling 110. Professional rubrics must be atomic, verifiable, unambiguous, independent, and aligned. ReAct agents have at most 30 reasoning turns and 16k tokens per turn; commercial agents use default web configurations. General reports undergo blind human pairwise review with five categorical judgments and four dimensions. Finance/law reports receive automated LLM scores against expert rubrics, with severe negative criteria able to zero a report. The paper overview reports Elo-style ratings, while the 70-item experiment presents Win/Tie/Loss comparisons; professional results are rubric scores.
evidence_summary_zh: ADR-Bench 调研真实中文深度研究用法，从领域专家草稿出发，经多轮测试、过滤和修订移除不适合的问题。九个领域分为双轨：七个通用领域各选 10 个真实业务问题（70），金融与法律各由专家设计 20 个问题及交叉验证 rubric（40），共 110 题。专业 rubric 必须满足原子性、可验证性、无歧义、独立性和对齐性。ReAct 智能体最多 30 个推理轮次、每轮 16k token；商业智能体使用默认网页配置。通用报告做盲审人工两两对比，使用五类总体判断与四个维度；金融/法律报告由 LLM 按专家 rubric 自动评分，严重负向项可将报告直接判零。论文概述报告 Elo 风格评级，而 70 题实验呈现胜/平/负对比；专业轨输出 rubric 得分。

source_locator: Official Artificial Analysis methodology and public dataset card; no standalone paper exists
evidence_summary_en: AA-LCR contains 100 hard text questions over 30 real-world document sets: 234 documents and 2,979,757 total tokens, with completed prompts averaging 99,325 tokens. Seven document types cover company reports, industry reports, government consultations, academia, legal, marketing, and survey reports. Team members and contracted undergraduates write practical general or mathematical questions that require multi-document reasoning rather than direct retrieval. GPT-4o-mini, Llama 3.1 70B, and Gemini 1.5 Flash check difficulty without selecting against frontier systems. Human validators independently solve the same documents; failures are revised or discarded and every retained item is solved by at least one human. Documents are prompted in filename order. Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507 in non-reasoning mode judges semantic equality as CORRECT or INCORRECT, and the benchmark reports accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: AA-LCR 含 100 道高难文本题，基于 30 个真实世界文档集、234 篇文档和 2,979,757 tokens，完整提示平均 99,325 tokens。七类文档覆盖公司、行业、政府咨询、学术、法律、营销和调研报告。团队成员与受聘本科生编写需要多文档通用或数学推理、不能直接检索作答的真实场景问题；GPT-4o-mini、Llama 3.1 70B 与 Gemini 1.5 Flash 在不针对前沿模型的前提下检查难度。人工验证者基于同一文档独立解题，失败项修改或丢弃，每道保留题至少一人解出。提示按文件名顺序放入文档。非推理模式 Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507 判断候选答案与标准答案的语义等价性，输出 CORRECT/INCORRECT，最终报告准确率。

evidence_summary_en: AIGCBench combines three sources. It subtype-samples 1,000 video-text pairs from WebVid10M validation for reference-video evaluation and randomly samples 925 LAION-Aesthetics image-text pairs for reference-free metrics. A text combiner draws subject, behavior, background, and style to create 3,000 prompts; GPT-4 enriches them, SDXL Base renders 1280×720 16:9 images, and T2I-CompBench metrics retain the top 2,003 pairs. The merged benchmark has 3,928 cases. I2V models generate videos from each image and text; unless specified otherwise evaluation uses the first 16 frames and four reference keyframes where needed. Eleven metrics span control-video alignment, motion effects, temporal consistency, and video quality, using CLIP, MSE, SSIM, RAFT flow, frame count, and DOVER variants. A 42-person study samples 30 results from each of five methods and votes on the same four dimensions.
evidence_summary_zh: AIGCBench 合并三类来源：从 WebVid10M 验证集按子类型采样 1,000 个视频-文本对用于参考视频评测，从 LAION-Aesthetics 随机采样 925 个图像-文本对用于无参考指标；文本组合器从主体、行为、背景与风格生成 3,000 条提示，经 GPT-4 扩写后由 SDXL Base 以 1280×720、16:9 生成图像，并用 T2I-CompBench 指标筛出前 2,003 对。合并后共 3,928 个样本。图生视频模型从图像和文本生成视频；除特别说明外取前 16 帧，需要时取四个参考关键帧。11 项指标覆盖控制-视频对齐、运动效果、时序一致性与视频质量，包括 CLIP、MSE、SSIM、RAFT 光流、帧数与 DOVER 等。42 人用户研究从五种方法各采样 30 个结果，在相同四维度投票。

source_locator: Sections 2-4 and the official facebookresearch/airs-bench repository
evidence_summary_en: AIRS-Bench sources SOTA tasks from PapersWithCode and papers published mainly from 2020-2025, preferring available Hugging Face data with train/test splits. Authors manually create each task, verify the cited metric, split, and protocol, and update SOTA when a better compatible result exists. Roughly 100 candidates from roughly 85 papers and datasets are down-selected using agent-performance fidelity, ranking fidelity, category balance, and tractability. The final 20 tasks come from 17 papers and 16 datasets across seven categories. Each package provides metadata.yaml, project_description.md, prepare.py, evaluate.py, and evaluate_prepare.py. Agents receive training labels but hidden test labels and no baseline code, with internet/cache access. AIRA-dojo One-Shot/Greedy and MLGym ReAct agents run for 24 hours on one H200. Raw task scores are transformed with φ(s)=−log10|s−optimal| and normalized so the worst observed run is 0 and literature SOTA is 1. Reports include average normalized score, valid submission rate, and pairwise Elo.
evidence_summary_zh: AIRS-Bench 从 PapersWithCode 与主要发表于 2020-2025 年的论文获取 SOTA 任务，优先使用可获得、含训练/测试划分的 Hugging Face 数据。作者人工创建每项任务，核验引用指标、划分与协议，若存在更优且兼容结果则更新 SOTA。约 85 篇论文和数据集形成约 100 个候选，再依据 Agent 表现保真度、排序保真度、类别平衡与可操作性筛选。最终 20 项任务来自 17 篇论文与 16 个数据集，覆盖七类。每个任务包含 metadata.yaml、project_description.md、prepare.py、evaluate.py 与 evaluate_prepare.py。Agent 可见训练标签但测试标签隐藏，不提供基线代码，可联网/用缓存；AIRA-dojo One-Shot/Greedy 与 MLGym ReAct 在单张 H200 上运行 24 小时。原始分数经 φ(s)=−log10|s−最优值| 转换，使最差观测运行归一为 0、文献 SOTA 为 1，并报告平均归一化分数、有效提交率与两两 Elo。

source_locator: Sections 2-4 and the official ByteDance-Seed/AInsteinBench repository
evidence_summary_en: AInsteinBench selects PySCF, Qiskit, Einstein Toolkit, AMReX, OpenMM, and RDKit for community acceptance, scientific breadth, maintenance, and reproducible tests. One pipeline mines merged scientific/numerical issue-resolution PRs and extracts the issue, base commit, fix patch, and test patch. A second synthesizes feature tasks by ablating modules or source components while retaining surrounding context; only signatures actually used by tests are supplied as a Minimal API block. Historical dependencies and build paths are reconstructed in isolated minimal Docker environments. A task must show base plus original tests PASS, added test patch FAIL, and added gold fix PASS. Domain experts verify scientific relevance and clarity, repair under- or over-covering tests, and score scientific plus engineering difficulty. The release contains 244 problems across six repositories. CodeAct agents inspect, edit, install, and test in a plan-act loop; reproduction and repository tests determine resolution, reported by repository, domain, type, and difficulty.
evidence_summary_zh: AInsteinBench 按社区认可、科学广度、维护状态和可复现测试选择 PySCF、Qiskit、Einstein Toolkit、AMReX、OpenMM 与 RDKit。第一条管线挖掘已合并的科学/数值计算问题修复 PR，提取 Issue、基线提交、修复补丁与测试补丁；第二条管线通过删除模块或源码组件、保留周边上下文来合成功能任务，仅将测试实际使用的签名作为 Minimal API 块提供。历史依赖与构建路径在隔离的最小 Docker 环境中重建。任务必须满足基线+原测试 PASS、加测试补丁 FAIL、加标准修复 PASS。领域专家核验科学相关性与清晰度，修复覆盖不足或过度的测试，并评定科学+工程难度。最终发布六个代码库共 244 题。CodeAct Agent 在规划-行动循环中检查、编辑、安装与测试，由复现脚本和代码库测试判断是否解决，并按代码库、领域、类型与难度报告。

source_locator: Sections 3-5 and the official bigheiniu/ALERT-LLMRecomBenchmark repository
evidence_summary_en: ALERT starts from Amazon Reviews 2023 across 15 e-commerce categories. The most recent purchase is the target item, represented by title, price, and merchant; earlier purchases form the preference history without demographics or user IDs. Quality control requires at least six alphabetic title characters, users with 5-20 purchases, only five-star purchases, and at most 200 behaviors per category, leaving 2,761 interactions. An e-commerce editorial team and user studies define reasoning/context consistency, clear and concise language, engaging narrative, and neutral tone. Candidate explanations are compared with PreferenceLogic. ALERT-Gen uses Claude-3-Sonnet chain-of-thought to output A/B/C with systematic position swaps; ALERT-Disc compares ArmoRM scores. Both judge the four criteria separately and majority-vote the final preference. Win rate is the percentage of interactions where the candidate beats baseline. Controlled data/prompt interruptions and three professional annotators meta-evaluate reliability, yielding about 70% expert concordance.
evidence_summary_zh: ALERT 从 Amazon Reviews 2023 的 15 个电商类别开始。最近一次购买作为目标商品，以标题、价格和商家表示；此前购买形成偏好历史，不使用人口统计或用户 ID。质量控制要求标题至少六个字母、用户有 5-20 次购买、仅保留五星购买且每类最多 200 条行为，最终保留 2,761 个交互。电商编辑团队与用户研究制定推理/上下文一致性、清晰简洁、叙事吸引力和中性语气四项准则。候选解释与 PreferenceLogic 比较。ALERT-Gen 使用 Claude-3-Sonnet 思维链输出 A/B/C 并系统交换位置；ALERT-Disc 比较 ArmoRM 分数。两者均分别判断四项准则，再以多数投票得到最终偏好。胜率为候选优于基线的交互占比。受控数据/提示干扰和三位专业标注者用于元评测，专家一致性约 70%。

source_locator: MathArena Sections 2-5, appendices, and the official matharena.ai site
evidence_summary_en: The AIME catalog entry represents MathArena rather than a single annual AIME dataset. MathArena monitors reputable recurring competitions, selects challenging events, extracts original problems and solutions, standardizes templates, and manually checks typos, inconsistencies, and formatting. Its paper snapshot has 162 problems from AIME (30), HMMT (30), BRUMO (30), CMIMC (40), USAMO (6), IMO (6), and Project Euler (20). Models are selected for leadership, open-weight relevance, or cost-performance; each competition uses provider-recommended untuned settings and four responses per problem near release. Final answers require boxed output and pass through a custom LaTeX-to-SymPy parser, Gemini 2.5 Flash cross-check, and manual disagreement review. Proofs use expert rubrics and two independent anonymized graders with partial credit. Paired permutation produces rank intervals, Bernoulli modeling produces accuracy intervals, and the public leaderboard exposes scores and responses.

source_locator: MAA invitational-competition specification and the HuggingFaceH4/aime_2024 dataset card; no standalone benchmark paper exists
evidence_summary_en: MAA defines AIME as a 15-question, three-hour invitational exam after AMC 10/12, with every answer an integer from 000 to 999. AIME I is the primary date and AIME II is the alternate date; a real student may take only one. The public AIME-24 benchmark instead combines the 15 problems from each 2024 form into 30 problem/answer records. Evaluation prompts a model with one problem, optionally samples one or k responses, extracts an explicit final numeric answer, normalizes it to the 000-999 key, and applies integer exact match. Accuracy is the direct metric; Avg@k or Mean@k is a repeated-sampling harness aggregation, not an MAA competition rule.

source_locator: Benchmark construction, reask, evaluator-reliability, and scoring sections plus the official repository
evidence_summary_en: AMEGA selects current guidelines from highly regarded US and global medical organizations. Physicians with more than five years of clinical experience translate them into 20 fictional cases across 13 specialties, 135 sequential open-ended questions, and 1,337 weighted scoring elements, with a maximum of 50 points per case. At least one additional physician reviews every case; iterative refinement takes 20-30 hours per case and more than 400 hours total. Candidate models take a zero-shot oral exam one question at a time. GPT-4-0613 extracts clinical concepts and returns a criterion-level Boolean vector. Unmet allowed criteria trigger guided reasks, while critical errors with immediate consequences skip reasking. Eleven parallel evaluations per criterion are majority-voted with agreement-derived confidence. Weighted Boolean outcomes produce question and case scores, a 50-point mean, normalized deficiencies, and cost. Reliability is checked with 50-run simulations, two clinical-expert cases, and spot checks on cases 3 and 5. The later repository expands to 24 cases, 163 questions, and 1,497 criteria; the diagram intentionally preserves the paper snapshot.
evidence_summary_zh: AMEGA 从权威美国及全球医学组织选择现行指南。具有五年以上临床经验的医生将其转化为跨 13 个专业的 20 个虚构病例、135 个顺序开放问题和 1,337 个加权评分元素，每病例最高 50 分。每个病例至少由另一位医生复核，迭代完善每例需 20-30 小时、总计超过 400 小时。候选模型逐题参加零样本口试；GPT-4-0613 提取临床概念并返回逐准则布尔向量。允许补充的未满足准则触发引导式重问，会造成即时后果的关键错误则跳过重问。每项准则运行 11 次并行评估，以多数投票和一致率置信度汇总。布尔结果乘权重后得到问题/病例分、50 分均值、归一化缺陷与成本。可靠性通过 50 次模拟、两个临床专家病例和病例 3/5 抽查验证。后续仓库扩展到 24 病例、163 问题、1,497 准则；图中刻意保留论文快照。

source_locator: Dataset construction and evaluation sections plus the official AMO-Bench project page
evidence_summary_en: AMO-Bench uses four construction stages. Mathematics experts create original problems with final answers and step-by-step solutions. At least three experts blind-review correctness, clarity, ambiguity, and solution quality. Originality is checked with 10-gram matching against existing sets including AIME 2024/2025, web search, and expert memory. Difficulty requires human IMO-level-or-harder agreement and consistent failure by at least two advanced models; each model receives three samples and all three must be correct to count as a consistent solve. The final 50 problems span algebra 11, functions/sequences 13, geometry 5, number theory 9, and combinatorics 12. Each evaluated model produces 32 responses per problem at temperature 1.0 for reasoning models or 0.7 otherwise, top-k 50, top-p 0.95, and maximum available length. A math-verify-style parser handles 39 numeric, set, variable-expression, and four-decimal-precision answers; o4-mini (Low) judges 11 descriptive answers with five-vote majority. Parser outputs receive manual review, and the hybrid grader reaches 99.2% accuracy on 1,000 responses from ten LLMs. Reports include AVG@32, Pass@32, output length, categories, and AMO-Bench-P.
evidence_summary_zh: AMO-Bench 采用四阶段构建：数学专家原创题目、最终答案与逐步解答；至少三位专家盲审正确性、清晰度、歧义和解答质量；用 10-gram 对已有集合（含 AIME 2024/2025）匹配、网页搜索和专家记忆检查原创性；难度需人类确认达到或超过 IMO，且至少两个先进模型不能稳定解出，每模型采样三次，三次全对才算稳定解出。最终 50 题含代数 11、函数/数列 13、几何 5、数论 9、组合 12。每个被测模型每题生成 32 个回答，推理模型温度 1.0、其他模型 0.7，top-k 50、top-p 0.95、使用最大可用长度。39 个数值、集合、变量表达式和四位小数精度答案由 math-verify 类解析器处理；11 个描述答案由 o4-mini (Low) 五次多数投票。解析器结果人工复核，混合评分器在十个 LLM 的 1,000 个回答上达 99.2% 准确率。报告 AVG@32、Pass@32、输出长度、类别与 AMO-Bench-P。

evidence_summary_en: ARC-AGI-1 operationalizes skill-acquisition efficiency and developer-aware generalization. Tasks are mostly manually authored around objectness, goal-directedness, numbers, and elementary geometry/topology, avoiding language, facts, and a shared generator. Grids are 1x1-30x30 with values 0-9, typically three demonstrations and one test pair. The original public corpus has 400 training and 400 evaluation tasks; ARC Prize later adds 100 semi-private and 100 private. Test takers infer a latent program and construct every output dimension and cell. All test pairs must match exactly. The 2019 paper allows three trials with binary feedback; later ARC Prize leaderboards use two predictions and Pass@2.

source_locator: Sections 2-4 (failure analysis, four-stage task pipeline, and preliminary evaluation)
evidence_summary_en: ART is the Action-based Reasoning Task benchmark for medical AI agents. It first analyzes MedAgentBench outputs to identify retrieval, aggregation, and threshold/conditional failures, then mines 50,000 EHR observations from 695 patients. Retrieval scenarios cover 11 lab codes and sparse, clustered, or 23-25-hour edge cases; aggregation uses at least three valid readings in 24-hour windows for glucose, potassium, and sodium; conditional tasks span seven value ranges and demographic thresholds. GPT-4o-mini or Claude 3.5 varies only instruction phrasing and context while authentic clinical values remain unchanged. The balanced set contains 200 tasks per category, with instruction, context, EHR-derived ground truth, and anonymized MRN. Automatic source checks and representative clinical HITL review precede stateless temperature-0 MedAgentBench/FHIR R5 evaluation. Exact-match success rate is reported by category.

source_locator: Sections 2-6 (framework, Asper-Bench, evaluator, results, and error analysis)
evidence_summary_en: ASPERA implements a simulated company assistant library with seven databases and 69 Python primitives. A developer starts an interactive GPT-4o session using library documentation, natural-language policies, focus or human-authored queries, and five in-context examples per program type. Each task is a four-part contract: user query, reference Action Execution Program (AEP), State Initialization Program (SIP), and Evaluation Program (EP). The developer may execute, filter, and edit every generated program; EP assertions cover return values, state changes, multiple acceptable outcomes, and conditional branches. The lead author executes/corrects the final set and two annotators confirm quality. Asper-Bench has 250 tasks: 71 information-seeking and 179 state-mutating. Evaluation uses either complete codebase knowledge or module-by-module primitive selection, generates a candidate AEP, executes SIP then AEP, and counts task success only if execution is error-free and every reference EP assertion passes; primitive selection also reports precision, recall, and micro F1.

source_locator: Sections 2-3 and Appendix A plus the official llm-attacks repository
evidence_summary_en: AdvBench has two distinct 500-item settings. Harmful Strings spans toxic, threatening, misleading, discriminatory, cybercrime, dangerous, and illegal content; strings are 3-44 LLaMA tokens with mean length 16, and success requires exact target elicitation. Harmful Behaviors expresses the same broad themes as instructions, and success means a reasonable attempt to comply rather than refuse, with human judgment when needed. GCG initializes a 20-token suffix and repeatedly uses top-k 256 gradient substitutions, batch size 512, and lowest-loss coordinate replacement for 500 steps. Individual tests use the first 100 items; universal attacks optimize one suffix on 25 behaviors and test 100 held-out behaviors; transfer optimizes on 25 behaviors over two or four source models and evaluates 388 test behaviors. Results compare PEZ, GBDA, AutoPrompt, and GCG using ASR, universal train/test ASR, transfer ASR, and target cross-entropy loss for strings.
evidence_summary_zh: AdvBench 包含两个独立的 500 项集合。有害字符串覆盖有毒、威胁、误导、歧视、网络犯罪、危险与非法内容，长度为 3-44 个 LLaMA token、均值 16，必须精确诱导目标字符串才成功。有害行为把同类主题写成指令，成功指合理尝试遵从而非拒答，必要时人工判定。GCG 初始化 20-token 后缀，以梯度 top-k 256、批量 512 和最低损失坐标替换迭代 500 步。单题测试用前 100 项；通用攻击在 25 个行为上优化后缀并测试 100 个留出行为；迁移攻击在 25 个行为和 2 或 4 个源模型上优化，再评测 388 个行为。结果比较 PEZ、GBDA、AutoPrompt 与 GCG，并报告 ASR、通用训练/测试 ASR、迁移 ASR 及字符串目标交叉熵损失。

source_locator: Section 3 (benchmark design, collection, and SoTA evaluation) plus the official Meta dataset
evidence_summary_en: AdvancedIF contains 1,645 human-written dialogs and human-written rubrics across three categories: 402 explicit/complex single-turn dialogs with 7.44 criteria on average, 736 carried-context dialogs averaging 7.69 turns and 6.08 criteria, and 507 system-steerability dialogs averaging 11.21 turns and 9.81 criteria. Complex prompts contain at least six tone, format, style, structure, length, negative, spelling, or inter-conditional instructions. Multi-turn annotators first converse with a provided LLM and place instructions in the last turn; only prompts that trigger an instruction-following failure in the final response are retained. The same expert decomposes applicable final-turn instructions into up to 20 separately verifiable binary criteria; multi-turn rubrics cover only the last turn. At evaluation, o3-mini judges every criterion separately. A dialog receives TRUE only if all criteria pass, and strict pass percentages are reported for CIF, CC, SS, and their average.
