evidence_summary_en: AfriMed-QA v4 contains 15,275 items from 621 contributors, more than 60 medical schools, 16 countries, and 32 specialties. Contributors are capped at 300 items; clinician access is credential-checked. Professors provide 3,910 expert MCQs and 359 SAQs. Trainees and clinicians provide 129 crowdsourced MCQs and 877 SAQs. A curated list of 472 African-relevant conditions and complaints prompts 10,000 consumer queries, with clinicians supplying answers. Clinicians cross-check question, answer, and rationale quality against authoritative sources; only contributors with at least 80% positive ratings continue. The release has 4,269 expert and 11,006 crowdsourced items, with human answers/explanations for 5,444. Thirty LLMs (17 open, 13 proprietary) are evaluated. MCQs use single-letter accuracy; open answers use BERTScore, QuestEval, and ROUGE-Lsum. A random 3,000-response subset receives 37,435 double-blind five-point ratings from 58 clinicians and 321 non-clinicians on role-specific correctness, localization, omission, hallucination, harm, relevance, and helpfulness axes.

source_locator: Sections 3-4 and appendices (construction, quality control, scorer, and 16-agent evaluation)
evidence_summary_en: Agent-SafetyBench defines eight risk categories and ten failure modes, then standardizes each case as risks, instruction/dialog, environments, and anticipated failure modes. Six prior datasets are clarified, deduplicated, and normalized; 50 AdvBench prompts combined with jailbreak templates help form 876 refined cases. GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and Gemini 1.5 propose 300 new environment names, and GPT-4o generates risk-controlled cases plus expected risky behaviors, producing 1,124 new valid cases. The final 2,000 cases are balanced at 250 per risk category and use 349 configurable JSON-schema/Python-class environments. Author precheck, executable validation, 4,000 manually labeled GPT-4o-mini/Claude interaction records, revisions, and cross-validation precede release. Qwen2.5-7B is fine-tuned on those records, reaches 91.5% held-out accuracy, and scores complete trajectories from 16 agents; safety score is the safe-trajectory ratio with risk and failure-mode analysis.

source_locator: Sections 3-4 and Appendix B (task generation, end-to-end evaluation, judge validation, and mitigations)
evidence_summary_en: AgentDAM operationalizes data minimization as using potentially sensitive information only when necessary for a task. It selects isolated Reddit, Shopping, and GitLab replicas from (Visual)WebArena and defines eight task types plus six sensitive-data categories. Human annotators write user instructions and 123 data seeds containing a PLOT and task-irrelevant SENSITIVE_DATA that fits naturally as background. An LLM generates coherent long-form user_data twice per seed, yielding 246 tasks. Agents receive accessibility trees, SOM-enhanced views, or screenshots and act end to end in reset self-hosted environments. Utility is a binary final-state reward. GPT-4o with CoT judges each action for unnecessary disclosure; four human evaluators agree with it 98%. Reports combine task success, leakage rate, and privacy performance, and compare pre-filtering, post-filtering, and the paper's privacy-aware system prompt with CoT demonstrations.
evidence_summary_zh: AgentDAM 把数据最小化定义为仅在任务确有必要时使用潜在敏感信息。它从 (Visual)WebArena 选择隔离的 Reddit、Shopping 与 GitLab 副本，定义 8 类任务和 6 类敏感数据。人工编写用户指令与 123 个数据种子；每个种子含 PLOT，以及能自然嵌入背景但与任务无关的 SENSITIVE_DATA。LLM 对每个种子生成两份连贯长篇 user_data，共 246 题。Agent 获取无障碍树、SOM 增强视图或截图，并在重置后的自托管环境中端到端行动。效用由最终状态二元奖励判定；GPT-4o CoT 对每个操作判断非必要披露，四名人工评审与其一致率 98%。报告结合任务成功率、泄露率和隐私表现，并比较前置过滤、后置过滤及论文默认的隐私系统提示 + CoT 示例。

source_locator: Sections 3-4 and appendices (behaviors, tools, rubrics, splits, jailbreaks, and metrics)
evidence_summary_en: AgentHarm covers 11 harm categories with ten human-written base behaviors each. The 110 explicitly malicious, digitally realizable behaviors require dependent multi-step calls while avoiding real identities and locations; a separate reviewer checks every item. Detailed and open-ended forms, each with and without a first-tool hint, produce 440 harmful tasks, and matched benign counterparts test the same competencies without malicious intent. The benchmark implements 104 side-effect-free tools in Inspect and human-written rubrics for target calls, ordering, arguments, and narrow semantic conditions. Validation/public/private splits are 44/264/132. Evaluation compares direct prompts, forced tool calls, and a universal jailbreak template, grades complete trajectories with partial credit, judges refusal over every agent message, and reports Harm Score, refusal rate, non-refusal performance, and benign capability controls.

source_locator: Sections 2-3 and appendices (challenge, ART curation, query-budget ASR, transfer, and universality)
evidence_summary_en: The Agent Red Teaming Challenge manually defines 44 simulated deployment scenarios with an agent, tool environment, adversarial goal, policy, and success criteria across confidentiality breaches, conflicting objectives, prohibited information, and prohibited actions. Gray Swan ran four waves from March 8 to April 6, 2025 against 22 anonymized frontier agents. Public red-teamers submitted 1.8 million direct and indirect prompt-injection interactions; automated judging with a human appeal path identified more than 60,000 policy violations. ART is not that raw pool: a stricter LLM judge re-filters successes, then samples up to five high-quality attacks per behavior-model pair, yielding 4,700 attacks over all 44 behaviors. Nineteen challenge and unseen models are replayed at k=1, 10, and 100 queries. Behavior ASR counts the fraction of behaviors broken at least once, and the paper also measures source-to-target transfer and cross-behavior universal attack clusters.
evidence_summary_zh: Agent Red Teaming Challenge 人工定义 44 个模拟部署场景，每个场景包含 Agent、工具环境、对抗目标、策略和成功判据，覆盖机密泄露、目标冲突、禁止信息与禁止行动四类违规。Gray Swan 于 2025-03-08 至 04-06 分四阶段对 22 个匿名前沿 Agent 运行挑战赛。公开红队提交 180 万次直接/间接提示注入交互；带人工申诉路径的自动评审识别出 6 万多次策略违规。ART 并非这个原始池：论文用更严格的 LLM 评审器重筛成功样本，再按行为-模型组合最多采样 5 条，得到覆盖全部 44 个行为的 4,700 条攻击。19 个挑战赛与未见模型按 k=1、10、100 次查询重放。行为 ASR 统计至少被攻破一次的行为占比，另分析来源到目标模型的迁移和跨行为通用攻击簇。

source_locator: Sections 3-4 and Figure 3 (scene selection, question construction, paired items, and evaluation)
evidence_summary_en: All-Angles starts from 83 Ego-Exo4D and seven EgoHumans scenes. Authors manually retain 90 scenes with at least three useful viewpoints, then form four-to-five spatially dispersed views per scene and resize images to 796x448. Six tasks test counting, attributes, relative distance, relative direction, object manipulation, and camera pose. GPT-4o drafts three questions per category and scene except one camera-pose question; counting and camera pose use all views, while the other tasks use two random views. Eight STEM PhD annotators review every item, remove invalid questions, improve wording and options, and enforce three choices with one correct answer. Controlled rephrasing, orientation swaps, or view changes create paired items while preserving correspondence; final human QC yields 2,132 QA pairs, with 85.3% paired coverage excluding counting. Twenty-seven MLLMs are scored by overall/category accuracy and paired inconsistency, with a stratified 250-question human reference.

source_locator: Sections 2-4 plus the MathArena ArXivMath methodology pages
evidence_summary_en: ArXivMath is refreshed monthly from mathematics papers submitted to arXiv in the previous month. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview with medium reasoning reads titles and abstracts, targets central results, and proposes self-contained questions with one automatically verifiable final answer. Roughly 200 monthly candidates pass filters for missing context, guessability from prior work, explicit AI use, and author expertise; DeepSeek-OCR-2 converts full papers to recover assumptions. The benchmark authors manually review well-definedness, non-triviality, and interest, then paper authors review and doubtful items are removed, leaving roughly 30 questions per month. Models run four times with default parameters and no tools. A SymPy-based parser checks exact equivalence, formatting failures trigger answer restatement, an LLM cross-checks parser decisions, and humans resolve the fewer-than-one-percent disagreements. Results report average final-answer accuracy, cost, and monthly version, with post-run review able to remove ambiguous questions.
evidence_summary_zh: ArXivMath 每月从上一个月提交到 arXiv 的数学论文更新。Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 以中等推理读取标题和摘要，围绕核心结果生成自包含且只有一个可自动验证最终答案的问题。每月约 200 个候选题经缺失上下文、是否可从既有工作猜出、是否明确使用 AI、作者专业性等过滤；DeepSeek-OCR-2 把全文转为 Markdown 以补齐必要假设。基准作者人工检查定义清晰、非平凡与有趣性，再由论文作者复核并移除存疑问题，每月约发布 30 题。模型按默认参数运行 4 次且不使用工具。SymPy 解析器判定精确等价，格式失败时要求模型重述答案，LLM 交叉检查解析结果，人工解决少于 1% 的分歧。最终报告平均准确率、成本与月度版本，运行后复核也可移除歧义题。

source_locator: Arena-Hard-Auto paper plus official Arena-Hard v2.0 README and evaluation configs
evidence_summary_en: Arena-Hard v2.0 uses 750 fresh real Chatbot Arena queries: 500 challenging general prompts spanning software, mathematics, and other real-world problems, plus 250 creative-writing prompts. Candidate and reference-system answers are generated and cached by prompt and model. The official hard configuration uses Gemini 2.5 as judge with GPT-4.1 as a fast stable alternative; response length and Markdown density are attached as control features before hard-split aggregation. Creative writing is judged independently by GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.5 and aggregated as a judge ensemble. Pairwise outcomes distinguish candidate better, tie, and reference better. The reporting pipeline computes model win rates with bootstrap confidence intervals, checks benchmark separability with confidence and agreement with human preference, and publishes separate hard and creative results on the Arena-Hard v2.0 leaderboard.

source_locator: AstaBench and Asta Environment sections, benchmark table, and evaluation setup
evidence_summary_en: AstaBench combines product-informed tasks from deployed Asta agents with existing and newly constructed scientific evaluations. It has exactly 2,404 validation/test questions in 11 benchmarks grouped into literature understanding, code and execution, data analysis, and end-to-end discovery: Paper Finding 333, LitQA Search 85, ScholarQA 200, LitQA 85, ArxivDIGESTables 170, SUPER 95, CORE 72, DS-1000 1,000, Discovery 264, and two 50-item end-to-end sets. Cited datasets are modified or filtered where needed for answerability with standard tools. The controlled environment exposes the Asta Scientific Corpus through MCP with date cutoffs or paper-ID constraints and a stateful Python notebook sandbox capped at five minutes per cell. Inspect implementations and the agent-eval suite record task scores, uncertainty, and frozen LiteLLM dollar costs including cache discounts. Tooling-based agent categories expose confounders. Nine science-optimized Asta classes plus general and external baselines yield 57 agents across 22 classes, compared by benchmark performance, cost, and accuracy-cost Pareto frontiers.

source_locator: Sections 3-5 plus the official AthenaBench repository
evidence_summary_en: AthenaBench integrates authoritative CTI knowledge from MITRE ATT&CK, CWE, CAPEC, CISA, STIX/TAXII, GDPR, NVD/CVE/CVSS, APT reports, vendor reports, and security blogs. Its six tasks are CTI Knowledge Test, Attack Technique Enumeration, Root Cause Mapping, Risk Mitigation Strategy, Vulnerability Severity Prediction, and Threat Actor Attribution. GPT-5 generates five-option, one-answer CKT items for experienced CTI analysts; GPT-5 and Gemini flag issues and humans inspect or repair them. The full task counts are 3,000/500/2,000/500/2,000/100, totaling 8,100. Mini sampling uses 10% for CKT/RCM/VSP, 20% for ATE/RMS, and 50% for TAA. Ten random seeds are evaluated and the subset whose aggregate model performance is closest to the full benchmark is selected, yielding exactly 300/100/200/100/200/50 = 950 items. Twelve proprietary and open-source LLMs run at temperature zero where supported. CKT/ATE/RCM/TAA use accuracy, RMS uses multi-label F1, VSP parses CVSS and computes normalized 1 - MAD / 7.7, and six percentage-scale scores form a combined score.

source_locator: Dataset construction, quality control, fixed-context evaluation, and metric sections
evidence_summary_en: Audio MultiChallenge contains four axes: 132 Inference Memory, 120 Instruction Retention, 117 Self Coherence, and 83 Voice Editing conversations. Axis/topic/persona seeds drive an agentic Planner/Tester/TTS/target-audio-model loop until failure or a turn limit, producing human-friendly strategy blueprints rather than scripts. Humans freely rewrite, add, or pivot from each blueprint and record unscripted three-to-eight-turn conversations with pauses, noise, backchannels, disfluencies, and mid-utterance edits. Final-turn ideal behavior is decomposed into atomic binary rubrics. Trained reviewers, independent quality control, and an internal research-team audit precede release. The final dataset has 452 conversations, 47 speakers, 15 hours of audio, and 1,712 rubrics. At evaluation the full prior conversation is pre-seeded, user turns are base64 audio, assistant history is raw text, and the model generates only the final turn to avoid drift. An LLM judges each rubric. Average Pass Rate requires all rubrics for a task to pass, while Average Rubric Score averages criterion satisfaction.

source_locator: Benchmark construction, environment, evaluation, and limitations sections plus Zapier's official benchmark methodology
evidence_summary_en: AutomationBench derives privacy-safe task shapes from negative feedback on real Zapier Agent workflows and clusters them into Sales, Marketing, Operations, Support, Finance, and HR. Opus 4.6, GPT-5.3 Codex, and Gemini 3 synthesize candidates, which are iteratively hardened with distractors, hidden information, near-identical names, ambiguous locations, and layered policies. Tasks must cause an observable state mutation, admit deterministic validation, and fit one autonomous instruction; hint-mode inspection, repeated audits, and reinforcement-learning runs expose unsolvable items and reward hacking. The release has 600 public tasks, exactly 100 per domain, plus more than 600 additionally hardened private tasks. Each task boots a fresh Pydantic-backed simulated world spanning 47 apps and about 500 public-API-shaped endpoints. Agents have at most 50 steps, use BM25 top-five schema search and a method/URL/body execute tool, and may call tools in parallel. Positive and negative assertions inspect only final state, producing an all-or-nothing pass score; the private leaderboard reports strict pass rate and average USD cost.

source_locator: Sections 3-4, Figure 1, and the multi-trial and reasoning-behavior analyses
evidence_summary_en: BABE curates recent, domain-relevant, conceptually deep peer-reviewed biology papers, monographs, and authoritative reviews. A domain expert reads each source and authors a three-item set spanning conceptual understanding, methodological interpretation, and higher-order experimental reasoning. Items must be self-contained, unambiguous, faithful to the source, and resistant to superficial fact retrieval. Senior experts check relevance, factual fidelity, logical coherence, and answer correctness; inaccurate, ambiguous, or misaligned items return for repair and a second review. LLM assistance removes simple questions while retaining explicit relevance labels. Strong-correlation sets form a sequential Q1-to-Q2-to-Q3 chain whose earlier answers are required downstream, whereas weak-correlation sets independently extract evidence from distinct contexts in one source. The release covers 12 biology subfields with a reported 45% strong and 55% weak split; the paper does not disclose the final item count. Evaluation reports average, strong-subset, and weak-subset accuracy, compares repeated sampling at n=1,2,4,8 through average and Best-of-N gain/convergence, and analyzes deep reasoning, self-exploration, and self-reflection behavior.
evidence_summary_zh: BABE 筛选近期、领域相关且概念深度足够的同行评审生物学论文、专著与权威综述。领域专家阅读每个来源，编写由概念理解、方法解释和高阶实验推理组成的三题组。题目必须自包含、无歧义、忠于来源，且不能靠表面事实检索完成。资深专家检查相关性、事实忠实度、逻辑一致性和答案正确性；不准确、含糊或与来源错位的题目退回修订并再次审核。LLM 辅助移除简单题，同时保留明确的相关性标签。强相关题组形成 Q1→Q2→Q3 的顺序链，后续必须依赖前题答案；弱相关题组则从同一来源的不同上下文独立提取证据。最终覆盖 12 个生物学子领域，论文报告 45% 强相关、55% 弱相关，但未披露最终题目总数。评测报告总体、强相关和弱相关正确率，以 n=1、2、4、8 重复采样比较平均与 Best-of-N 增益/收敛，并分析深度推理、自探索和自反思行为。

source_locator: Sections 3-5, generation algorithm, context-length splits, and direct/RAG/recurrent-memory experiments
evidence_summary_en: BABILong programmatically generates all 20 original bAbI reasoning tasks, including fact chaining, induction, deduction, counting, list/set manipulation, spatial relations, time, and path reasoning. PG19 books supply natural long-form background. Relevant and distractor task sentences are interleaved between book sentences while preserving both the book's original order and the task's logical order. More background is added until a GPT-2 tokenizer reaches the target length, with task facts placed algorithmically. Reproducible splits are pre-generated at 0K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, 128K, 512K, 1M, and 10M tokens, while arbitrary lengths can also be generated. Evaluation compares direct long-context LLMs, RAG-C with 512-token chunks, and sentence-level RAG-S; the latter baselines expose temporal and multi-hop retrieval failures. RMT, ARMT, and Mamba are curriculum-fine-tuned by gradually increasing recurrent segments, then tested beyond training length, with selected runs reaching 50M tokens. Exact-answer accuracy is reported per task and length using 1,000 samples through 32K and 100 beyond, with refusals tracked separately where applicable. Final analysis compares direct, retrieval, and memory approaches and diagnoses effective context by task.

evidence_summary_en: BFCL V4 carries forward V1 expert single-turn simple/parallel/multiple calls, V2 community and enterprise live functions, and V3 multi-turn/multi-step interactions. Its agentic addition has 200 web-search entries and 465 memory entries. The 100 human-crafted web questions require recent but stable multi-hop facts; every hop and source is manually checked, ambiguous/common/duplicate/yes-no items are filtered, persona context is added, and DuckDuckGo search plus URL fetch simulate six probabilistic request failures. Each question runs with and without snippets and uses normalized exact matching. Memory authors create dialogues in support, health, advising, finance, and productivity, implement key-value, vector, and recursive-summary backends, snapshot and reload state between sessions, and ask isolated follow-ups requiring stored facts; each backend verifies 155 cases. A separate non-scoring format diagnostic selects 200 representative V2 items and crosses 26 return/documentation/tag/plaintext-or-Markdown/style configurations for 5,200 runs. The official score has 5,088 scored entries and 5,218 non-scoring diagnostics. AST checks score applicable single-turn/live/hallucination tasks, state transitions score multi-turn, and dedicated verifiers score web and memory. Overall accuracy weights Agentic/Multi-Turn/Live/Non-Live/Hallucination at 40/30/10/10/10, with category results, format robustness, cost, and latency also reported.

source_locator: Sections 3-4, Appendix A.5, dataset statistics, model protocol, and diagnostic analyses
evidence_summary_en: BLINK selects 14 visual-perception tasks: visual correspondence, relative reflectance, relative depth, spatial relation, multi-view reasoning, jigsaw, art style, object localization, counting, forensic detection, IQ test, visual similarity, semantic correspondence, and functional correspondence. It repurposes HPatches, IIW, DIW, VSR, Wild6D, TARA, WikiArt, LVIS, TallyQA, DreamSim, SPair-71k, and FunKPoint. New forensic data pairs SDXL images generated from COCO captions with manually found real photos, while IQ items come from license-friendly public sources with explanations. Task-specific points, frames, boxes, patches, counts, and source annotations become multiple-choice questions with single or multiple images and text or image options. Circles, boxes, masks, and reference points provide interleaved visual prompting. Every image is unique and all collected data are manually inspected to remove ambiguity. The paper's release has exactly 3,807 questions over about 7.3K images, split into 1,901 validation and 1,906 test items. Models run zero-shot at temperature zero with up to ten retries, no image resizing, and image concatenation where multi-image inputs are unsupported. Predefined rules parse answers, with GPT-3.5-turbo used for remaining outputs. Overall and per-task accuracy are compared with random, 95.70% human, MLLM, and specialist baselines; caption-only GPT-4 and visual-prompt size/color tests diagnose shortcuts and robustness.
evidence_summary_zh: BLINK 选择 14 类视觉感知任务：视觉对应、相对反射率、相对深度、空间关系、多视角推理、拼图、艺术风格、目标定位、计数、伪造检测、IQ 测试、视觉相似性、语义对应和功能对应。它复用 HPatches、IIW、DIW、VSR、Wild6D、TARA、WikiArt、LVIS、TallyQA、DreamSim、SPair-71k 与 FunKPoint。新伪造数据用 COCO caption 驱动 SDXL 生成图像并人工寻找匹配实拍图；IQ 题来自带解释、许可友好的公开来源。任务特定的点、帧、框、patch、计数和来源标注被改写为单图或多图、文本或图像选项的选择题。圆圈、框、遮罩与参考点形成图文交错视觉提示。每张图只出现一次，所有数据均人工检查以移除歧义。论文发布恰有 3,807 题、约 7.3K 张图，验证集 1,901、测试集 1,906。模型以温度 0 零样本运行，最多重试 10 次，不缩放图像；不支持多图时拼接图像。答案先按预定义规则解析，其余由 GPT-3.5-turbo 处理。总体与逐任务准确率和随机、人类 95.70%、MLLM、专用模型基线比较；仅 caption 的 GPT-4 以及视觉提示尺寸/颜色测试用于诊断捷径和鲁棒性。
